आ: आ The second letter of the alphabet, corresponding to A long, as in far, and written in the Roman character A.

आ ind. 1 A particle of reminiscence. (ah! oh!) 2 A conjunction disjunctive, (but.) 3 A particle of compassion, (ah! alas!) 4 A conjunction copulative, (and.) This particle remains unaltered in orthography even before vowels.

आ or आङ् A particle, and prefix to words, implying; 1 Diminution, (a little.) 2 Limit, inceptive, (from, from thence, or that time.) 3 Limit conclusive, (until, unto, as far as.) 4 Prefixed to verbs it extends or reverses their meaning, as रुह to rise, आरुह to ascend, to mount, and गम to go, आगम to come. 5 In composition with nouns it forms indeclinables, either crude, as आजानु to the knee, or with the terminations of the objective or ablative case, as आसमुद्रं or आसमद्रात् as far as to the ocean. 6 A particle of menace or of pain, (ah! alas!) this is more correctly written आस्. E. आप् to pervade, to obtain, and डाङ affix, प is dropped.
आ m. (-आः) A name of MAHĀDEVA.
आ ind. A particle of assent, yes, verily. E. अस to go, क्विप् affix, अ becomes आ.
आकम्पन: आकम्पन n. (-नं) Shaking, trembling. E. आङ् before कपि to tremble, ल्युट् aff.
आकम्पित: आकम्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, trembling. E. आङ् prefixed, कपि to shake, and क्त participial aff.
आकम्प्र: आकम्प्र mfn. (-म्प्रः-म्प्रा-म्प्रं) Trembling, shaking, agitated. E. आङ् before कपि to shake; रक aff.
आकर: आकर m. (-रः) 1 A mine. 2 A multitude. 3 Best, excellent. E. आङ् prefixed, कृ to make, &c. अप् aff.
आकरिन्: आकरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Mineral, produced in a mine, &c. E. आकर and इनि aff.
आकर्णन: आकर्णन n. (-नं) Hearing. E. आङ् before कर्ण to hear, ल्युट् aff.
आकर्णित: आकर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heard. E. आङ् कर्ण to hear, affix क्त.
आकर्ष: आकर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Pulling, hauling. 2 Pulling to or towards, dragging, attracting. 3 Attraction, fascination. 4 Magnetic attraction. 5 A magnet, a loadstone. 6 A dice or die. 7 Playing with dice. 8 A board for such a game. 9 Drawing the bow. 10 An organ of sense. 11 Spasm. E. आङ्, कृष to draw or make furrows, घञ् aff.
आकर्षक: आकर्षक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Attractive, what draws or attracts. m. (-कः) A magnet or loadstone. E. आकर्ष attraction, and वुन् aff.
आकर्षण: आकर्षण n. (-णं) Pulling, drawing, attracting. f. (-णी) 1 A crooked stick, for pulling down fruit, &c. 2 Any instrument for pulling. E. आङ् before कृष to pull, ल्युट् aff.
आकर्षिक: आकर्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Magnetic, attractive. E. आकर्ष and ष्ठल aff.
आकर्षित: आकर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drawn, attracted. E. आङ् before कृष to draw, क्त aff.
आकर्षिन्: आकर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) Attractive. f. (-णी) A rod with a hook at the end to pull down the boughs of trees, for the purpose of gathering the fruit. E. आङ् before कृष to draw, णिनि aff.
आकलन: आकलन n. (-नं) 1 Wish, desire. 2 Counting, reckoning. 3 Confinement, binding. 4 Laying hold of. E. आङ्, कल to count, sound, &c. and ल्युट् aff.
आकलित: आकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Counted, reckoned. 2 Seized, held, bound. E. आङ्ग before कल to count, &c. क्त aff.
आकल्प: आकल्प m. (-ल्पः) 1 Ornament, decoration. 2 Encreasing, adding to, improving. 3 Sickness, disease. E. आङ् before कृप to be able, to be weak, &c. घञ् aff.
आकल्पक: आकल्पक m. (-कः) 1 Remembering with regret, missing. 2 Fainting, loss of sense or perception. 4 Darkness. 4 A knot or joint. E. आङ्, कल्प from कृप to be able, to be weak, &c. and ण्वुल् aff.
आकष: आकष m. (-षः) A touchstone. E. आङ्, कष to injure, and अच aff.
आकषक: आकषक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Touching, assaying. E. वुन् added to the last.
आकषिक: आकषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Touching, testing. E. आकष and ष्ठल aff.
आकस्मिक: आकस्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sudden, unexpected, causeless. E. अक स्मात् and ठञ् aff.
आकाङ्क्षत्: आकाङ्क्षत् mfn. (-ङ्क्षन्-ङ्क्ष-अन्ती-ङ्क्षत्) 1 Wishing, expecting. 2 Looking at, to, or towards. E. आङ् before काङ्क्षि to desire, शतृ aff.
आकाङ्क्षनीय: आकाङ्क्षनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Desirable, to be desired or expected. E. आङ् before काक्षि to desire, अनीयर् affix; also आकाङ्क्षितब्य (-ब्यः-ब्या-ब्यं) and आकाङ्ख्य (-ङ्ख्यः-ङ्ख्या-ङ्ख्यं) with तब्य or यत् affs.
आकाङ्क्षा: आकाङ्क्षा f. (-ङ्क्षा) 1 Wish, desire. 2 Purpose, intention. 3 Looking at, to, or towards. 4 Enquiry, asking. 5 The presence of a word in a sentence indispensable to the sense. 6 The significancy of a word. E. आङ् prefixed to काक्षि to desire, अच् and टाप् aff.
आकाङ्क्षित: आकाङ्क्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wished, desired. 2 Asked, enquired. 3 Regarded, looked at. 4 Wanted, necessary. E. आङ् before काङ्क्षि to desire, क्त aff.
आकाङ्क्षिन्: आकाङ्क्षिन् mfn. (-ङ्क्षी-ङ्क्षिणी-ङ्क्षि) 1 Wishing, wishful. 2 Asking, enquiring, expectant. E. आकाङ्क्षा and इनि aff.
आकाय: आकाय m. (-यः) 1 A funeral pile. 2 Abode, residence. E. आङ् before चि to collect, घञ् affix, च changed to क.
आकार: आकार m. (-रः) 1 Hint, sign, token. 2 Form. 3 The letter आ. E. आङ्, कृ to make, affix घञ्.
आकारगुप्ति: आकारगुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Dissimulation. E. आकार and गुप्ति concealment, suppressing all sign or indication of the feelings.
आकारण: आकारण nf. (-णं-णा) Calling, a call or summons. E. आङ, कृ to make or do in the causal form, and ल्यु affix, fem. affix टाप्; sometimes written आकरण.
आकारवत्: आकारवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Symmetrical, handsome, well formed. E. आकार form, and मतुप् aff.
आकारित: आकारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Called, summoned. 2 Stipulated, agreed. 3 Demanded, exacted. E. आङ् before कृ to make, causal form, क्त aff.
आकालिक: आकालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Momentary, instantaneous. 2 Unseasonable, improper with respect to time. f. (-की) Lightning. E. अ neg. काल time, ठक् affix, fem. ङीप्.
आकालिकत्व: आकालिकत्व n. (-त्वं) Unseasonableness, suddenness. E. त्व added to the last.
आकाश: आकाश mn. (-शः-शं) 1 The fifth element, aether, the sky or atmosphere. 2 Brahma as identical with aether. 3 Space, vacuity. E. आङ् and काशृ to shine, घञ् affix; every where shining; Ākāśa is the subtle and ethereal fluid, supposed to fill and pervade the universe, and to be the peculiar vehicle of life and sound.
आकाशकक्षा: आकाशकक्षा f. (-क्षा) The horizon. E. आकाश and कक्षा girdle.
आकाशज: आकाशज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in the sky. E. आकाश and ज born.
आकाशजननिन्: आकाशजननिन् m. (-नी) A loop-hole, a casement, an embrasure. E. आकाश and जनविन् what generates, giving air and light.
आकाशदीप: आकाशदीप m. (-पः) 1 A lamp or torch lighted in honour of LAKṢMI or VIṢṆU, and elevated on a pole in the open air at the Dewali festival, in the month Kartik. 2 A beacon, a lanthorn on a pole. E. आकाश and दीप a lamp; also आकाशप्रदीपः.
आकाशभाषित: आकाशभाषित n. (-तं) 1 Speaking outside or off the stage, or a suppositious speech, which is replied to as if it had been spoken, (in dramatic language.) 3 A voice or sound in the air. E. आकाश and भाषित spoken.
आकाशमण्डल: आकाशमण्डल n. (-लं) The celestial sphere. E. आकाश and मण्डल a circle.
आकाशमांसी: आकाशमांसी f. (-सी) A plant, small Jaṭāmāṃsī, (Valeriana Jatamansi.)
आकाशमूली: आकाशमूली f. (-ली) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. आकाश and मूली having roots; having its root in air.
आकाशयान: आकाशयान n. (-नं) A heavenly car, one moving through the air. E. आकाश and यान vehicle.
आकाशरक्षिन्: आकाशरक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A warder, a watchman on the outer battlements. E. आकाश and रक्षिन् a guard.
आकाशवर्त्मन्: आकाशवर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) The atmosphere, the firmament, the air. E. आकाश and वर्त्मन् a road.
आकाशवल्ली: आकाशवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A sort of creeper, a parasite, (Cassyta filiformis.) E. आकाश and वल्ली pedicle.
आकाशवाणी: आकाशवाणी f. (-णी) A voice from heaven. E. आकाश and वाणी speech.
आकाशसलिल: आकाशसलिल n. (-लं) Rain. E. आकाश and सलिल water.
आकाशस्थ: आकाशस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Abiding in the sky. E. आकाश and स्थ what stays.
आकाशीय: आकाशीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Atmospherical. Also आकाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि).
आकाशे: आकाशे ind. In the air, a stage direction, implying something said by or to a person out of sight. E. 7th case of आकाश.
आकाशेश: आकाशेश m. (-शः) 1 INDRA, as ruler of the firmament. 2 (In law) A helpless person, as a child, a woman, a pauper or invalid. E. आकाश and ईश lord.
आकिञ्चन: आकिञ्चन n. (-नं) Poverty. E. अकिञ्चन poor, अण् aff.
आकीर्ण: आकीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Filled, overspread. 2 Crowded. 3 Impervious. 4 Spread. 5 Scattered. E. आङ्, कॄ to scatter, part. affix क्त.
आकीर्णता: आकीर्णता f. (-ता) 1 Fulness. 2 Crowd, multitude. E. आकीर्ण filled, तल् affix; also आकीर्णत्व.
आकुञ्चन: आकुञ्चन n. (-नं) 1 Compression, contraction, shrinking. 2 Collecting, heaping. 3 Curving, flexure. 4 Contortion. E. आङ् before कुचि to contract, ल्युट् aff.
आकुञ्चित: आकुञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bent, contracted. 2 Twisted, contorted. E. आङ् before कुचि to contract, affix क्त.
आकुण्ठित: आकुण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Confounded, abashed. E. आङ् before कुण्ठित abashed.
आकुल: आकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Confounded, confused, flurried. 2 Confused (in order), disordered. 3 Incoherent, contradictory. E. आङ्, कुल to accumulate, and क affix; not self-possessed.
आकुलत्व: आकुलत्व n. (-त्वं) Confusion, perplexity, bewilderment. E. आकुल and त्व affix; also with तल् affix आकुलता.
आकुलित: आकुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bewildered, flurried, agitated. 2 Distressed. E. आङ् before कुल, क्त aff.
आकुलीकृत: आकुलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bewildered, perplexed. E. आकुल and कृत made with च्चि aff.
आकुष्ठ: आकुष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Expelled, extracted. E. आकुष to extract, क्त aff.
आकूत: आकूत n. (-तं) 1 Meaning, intention. 2 Wish, desire. E. आङ्, कूङ to cry, affix क्त.
आकृति: आकृति f. (-तिः) 1 Form, figure. 2 The body. 3 Tribe, species. 4 A metre: a stanza of four lines, with twenty-two syllables to each line. E. आङ् before कृ to make or do, क्तिन् aff.
आकृष्ट: आकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Pulled, drawn. 2 Attracted. E. आङ् before कृष to drag, क्त aff.
आकृष्यमाण: आकृष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Drawing, attracting. E. आकृष to draw, शानच् aff.
आकृष्टवत्: आकृष्टवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Pulling, dragging, pulling up or out. 2 Pulling to, attracting. 3 Charming, fascinating. E. आकृष्ट and मतुप् aff.
आकृष्टि: आकृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Pulling, dragging. 2 Drawing, attraction. E. आङ् before कृष to drag, affix क्तिन्.
आकौशल: आकौशल n. (-लं) Inexpertness, want of skill or practice. E. अकुशल unskilful, affix अण् and the initial optionally long.
आक्रन्द: आक्रन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Who checks or restrains. m. (-न्दः) 1 Crying, crying out. 2 Calling. 3 Weeping, sobbing. 4 Sound. 5 Violence. 6 Furious or violent combat. 7 A friend. 8 A brother. 9 A king, a lord. 10 A usurper. 11 A king who  prevents an ally from aiding another. E. आङ्, क्रन्द to cry, to sound, &c. अच् aff.
आक्रन्दिक: आक्रन्दिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Going where sounds of distress are heard. E. आक्रन्द and ठञ् aff.
आक्रम: आक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Going over or beyond. 2 Surpassing. 3 Spreading over or upon. 4 Overloading. 5 Attaining, overcoming, obtaining. 6 Invading, attacking, falling upon. 7 Might, valour. E. आङ् before क्रम to go, to mount, ascend, surpass, &c. affix अच्.
आक्रमण: आक्रमण n. (-णं) 1 Going over or beyond. 2 Overpowering, subduing. 3 Spreading or extending over or upon. 4 Attacking, marching against, invading. E. आङ् before क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.
आक्रमणीय: आक्रमणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be attacked. 2 To be surpassed or overcome. 3 To be seized. E. आङ् before क्रम to go, अनीयर aff.
आक्रान्त: आक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Surpassed, surmounted. 2 Overcome, overrun. 3 Pained, distressed. 4 Accompanied, attended. 5 Overspread. 6 Obtained, possessed. 7 Agitated or overcome by, as a feeling. E. आक्रम to mount, surpass, &c. and part. affix क्त.
आक्रान्ति: आक्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Going over or beyond. 2 Overpowering. 3 Might, valour. E. आङ् before क्रम to go, affix क्तिन्: see आक्रम.
आक्रामक: आक्रामक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Invading, assailing 2 Overrunning. E. आङ् before क्रम to go, ण्वुल aff.
आक्रीड: आक्रीड m. (-डः) 1 A royal garden. 2 Sport, pleasure. E. आङ्, क्रीड to play, घञ् aff.
आक्रीडन: आक्रीडन n. (-नं) Sporting, taking pleasure. E. आक्रीड to sport, affix ल्युट्.
आक्रीडिन्: आक्रीडिन् mfn. (-डी-डिनी-डि) Sporting, playing. E. आक्रीड to play, घिनुण् aff.
आक्रुष्ट: आक्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Cursed. 2 Accused, calumniated. 3 Abused. 4 Vociferated. E. आङ् before क्रश to call, affix क्त.
आक्रोश: आक्रोश m. (-शः) 1 Abuse, censuring, a curse or oath. 2 Vociferousness, calling aloud. E. आङ्, क्रुश to call, घञ् aff.
आक्रोशक: आक्रोशक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Abusing, abusive. 2 Vociferous. E. आक्रुश to call, वुञ् aff.
आक्रोशन: आक्रोशन n. (-नं) Curse, imprecation. E. आङ्, क्रुश to call, ल्युट् aff.
आक्रोशनीय: आक्रोशनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be accursed, censurable, reprovable. E. आङ् before क्रुश to cry, अनीयर् affix; also आक्रुश्य and आक्रोशितव्य.
आक्षद्यूतिक: आक्षद्यूतिक mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Effected or completed by gambling. E. आक्षद्यूत and ठक् aff.
आक्षपण: आक्षपण n. (-णं) Fasting, or purification by fasting. E. आङ् before क्षप to endure, ल्युट् aff.
आक्षपाटिक: आक्षपाटिक m. (-कः) A judge. E. अक्ष a law suit, पट to go, causal form, उक affix; also आक्षपाटिक.
आक्षपाद: आक्षपाद m. (-दः) A logician. E. अक्ष dispute, पाद a division, अण affix; also अक्षपाद.
आक्षार: आक्षार m. (-रः) Accusation, calumny. E. आङ् before क्षर to go, affix घञ्.
आक्षारण: आक्षारण nf. (-णं-णा) 1 Calumnious accusation. 2 Abuse, reviling. E. आङ्, क्षर to go, with युच् aff.
आक्षारित: आक्षारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Calumniated, falsely accused. 2 Accused of adultery or fornication. 3 Falsely accused, of such crimes in particular. 4 Guilty, criminal. 5 Reviled, abused. E. आङ्, क्षर to go, part. affix क्त.
आक्षिक: आक्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating or belonging to a die, to gambling, &c. 2 Won at dice. m. (-कः) A tree. (Morinda tinctoria.) n. (-कं) A gambling debt, money lost at play. E. अक्ष a die, &c. and ठञ् aff.
आक्षिकपण: आक्षिकपण m. (-णः) A stake, a wager, a bet. E. आक्षिक and पण a wager.
आक्षिपत्: आक्षिपत् mfn. (-पन्-पती-पत्) 1 Excelling, so as to reproach or put to shame others. 2 Reviling, abusing. 3 Tossing. 4 Sending. E. आङ् before क्षिप् to throw, affix शतृ.
आक्षिप्त: आक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Cast, thrown, tossed. 2 Thrown down or away. 3 Borne, carried. 4 Reviled, abused, blamed, ridiculed. 5 Equal or equivalent to. E. आङ् before क्षिप to throw, क्त aff.
आक्षीब: आक्षीब m. (-बः) A plant, (Morunga guilandina and hyperanthera:) see अक्षीब.
आक्षेप: आक्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Throw, toss. 2 Abuse, reviling. 3 Censure, blame, reproach. 4 Attraction. 5 A figure in rhetoric, (irony.) E. आङ्, क्षिप to throw or send, घञ् aff.
आक्षेपक: आक्षेपक m. (-कः) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 Convulsion, spasm. 3 A detractor, a calumniator or accuser. 4 A thrower. E. आङ् before क्षिप to toss, ण्वुल् aff.
आक्षैत्रज्ञ: आक्षैत्रज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Spiritual ignorance. E. अ neg. क्षेत्रज्ञ wise, and ष्यञ affix, the initial optionally long.
आक्षोट: आक्षोट m. (-टः) A tree, (see पीलु,) growing in mountains: in Hindi, the corresponding name implies the walnut: see अक्षोट and आक्षोड.
आक्षोड: आक्षोड m. (-डः) A kind of Pilu, a tree so named, (Careya arborea:) see अक्षोड, अक्षोट and पीलु.
आक्षोद: आक्षोद m. (-दः) A Brahman of the Ṛkṣoda mountain. E. ऋक्षोद and अण् aff.
आख: आख m. (-खः) A spade, a hoe. E. आङ्, खन to dig, ड aff.
आखण्डल: आखण्डल m. (-लः) A name of INDRA. E. आङ् and खण्ड to break, अलच् affix; mountain-breaking, foe-destroying.
आखन: आखन m. (-नः) 1 A spade. 3 A digger. E. आङ्, खन to dig, घ aff.
आखनिक: आखनिक m. (-कः) 1 A thief. 2 A rat. 3 A hog. 4 A spade. 5 A digger, a ditcher, a miner. E. आङ्, खन to dig, and इकन् Uṇādi aff.
आखनिकवक: आखनिकवक m. (-कः) 1 A spade. 2 A digger. E. आङ्, before खन to dig, इकविक aff.
आखर: आखर m. (-रः) 1 A spade. 2 A digger. E. आङ्, खन to dig, डर aff.
आखात: आखात mn. (-तः-तं) A natural pond: see अखात.
आखान: आखान m. (-नः) 1 A spade. 2 A digger. E. आङ्, खन to dig, घञ् aff.
आखु: आखु m. (-खुः) 1 A rat, a mouse. 2 A hog. 3 A thief. 4 A sort of tree: see देबताड. E. आङ्, खन to dig, and कु Uṇādi aff.
आखुकर्णी: आखुकर्णी f. (-र्णी) The name of a plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. आखु a mouse, and कर्ण an ear; the leaves are compared to the ears of a mouse.
आखुग: आखुग m. (-गः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. आखु a rat, and ग who goes; GAṆEŚA is represented riding on a rat.
आखुघात: आखुघात m. (-तः) A Śūdra or man of low cast and profession, lit. a rat-catcher. E. आखु and घात a blow.
आखुपर्णिका: आखुपर्णिका f. (-का) A plant: see आखुकर्णी. E. आखु and पर्ण a leaf.
आखुपाषाण: आखुपाषाण m. (-णः) A kind of mineral, a loadstone. E. आखु and पाषाण a stone.
आखुभुज्: आखुभुज् m. (-भुक्) A cat. E. आखु and भुज् who eats.
आखुरथ: आखुरथ m. (-थः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. आखु and रथ a carriage; whose vehicle is a rat.
आखुविषहा: आखुविषहा f. (-हा) A kind of grass: (Andropogon serratum.) E. आखु, बिष venom, and हा what destroys; considered as a remedy for the bite of a rat.
आखूत्थ: आखूत्थ m. (-त्थः) The rising up or coming of rats, a swarm of rats. E. आखु and उत्थ from उत् and स्था with क aff.
आखेट: आखेट m. (-टः) 1 Chase, hunting. 2 Terror, fright. E. आङ्, खिट to alarm, घञ् aff.
आखेटक: आखेटक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Hunting, a hunter. 2 Frightening, frightful. n. (-कं) Hunting. E. आखेट and कन् pleonastic affix; or आङ् with खिट and खुल aff.
आखेटशीर्षक: आखेटशीर्षक n. (-कं) A cavern, a mine. E. आखेट terrifying, and शीर्ष the head or principal, क affix: very gloomy and terrifying.
आखेटिक: आखेटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Who or what hunts. 2 Terrible, frightful. m. (-कः) 1 A hound. 2 A hunter. E. आखेट chase, and ठक् aff.
आखोट: आखोट m. (-टः) The walnut tree. E. see अक्षोट, &c.
आख्या: आख्या f. (-ख्या) A name or appellation. E. ख्या to say, आङ् prefixed, अङ् and टाप् fem. aff.
आख्यात: आख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said, spoken. 2 Called, declared. 3 Made known. 4 Inflected, declined, conjugated. E. part. past of आख्या to say, to speak, &c.
आख्यान: आख्यान n. (-नं) 1 A tale, a legend. 2 Saying, declaring. E. आङ् before ख्या to tell, affix ल्युट्.
आख्यायक: आख्यायक m. (-कः) A messenger, a teller, an announcer or relater. f. (-यिका) A tale, a true or probable story. E. आख्या to say, ण्वुल् affix, यत्; inserted.
आख्येय: आख्येय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit or proper to be said. E. आङ् before ख्या to say, affix यत्; also आख्यातब्य.
आगत: आगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Arrived, come. 2 Received, obtained. 3 Living or residing in. E. आङ् before गम to go, क्त aff.
आगत्य: आगत्य ind. Having arrived. E. आङ् before गम to go, ल्यप् aff.
आगन्तब्य: आगन्तब्य mfn. (-ब्यः-ब्या-ब्यं) What will come, what is likely to arrive. E. आङ् and गम to go, तब्य aff.
आगन्तु: आगन्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) 1 Coming, arriving. 2 Incidental, adventitious. m. (-न्तुः) 1 A guest. 2 A stranger, a new comer. 3 An accident, any accidental hurt or wound. E. आङ् before गम to go, to come, तु affix; म becomes न; also आगान्तु and आगन्तुक.
आगन्तुक: आगन्तुक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 1 Incidental, adventitious, (as pleasure, pain, ornament, &c.) 2 Stray. m. (-कः) 1 A stranger, a new comer. 2 A guest. E. आगन्तु and कन् affix, what comes and goes; what is not inseparably inherent.
आगम: आगम m. (-मः) 1 Arrival, coming, approach. 2 A Śāstra or work on sacred science in general, supposed to be of divine origin. A Tantra or any work inculcating the mystical worship of SIVA and ŚAKTI. 4 A grammatical augment, a syllable or letter inserted in any part of the radical word. 5 Record, title deed, legal title, a voucher or written testimony, &c. E. आङ before गम to go, to come, अच् aff.
आगमन: आगमन n. (-नं) Arriving, coming. E. आङ् before गम to go, ल्युट् aff.
आगमनिरपेक्ष: आगमनिरपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Independent of a written voucher or title. E. आगम and निरपेक्षा disregard.
आगमय्य: आगमय्य ind. Having explored or discovered. E. आङ् before गम to go, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
आगमरहित: आगमरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Devoid of a written title or voucher. 2 Without a Śāstra. E. आगम and रहित devoid of.
आगमसापेक्ष: आगमसापेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) With or supported by legal vouchers. E. आगम and सापेक्ष regard to.
आगमापायिन्: आगमापायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Transient, of short duration. E. आगम and अपायिन् separating, going at the time of arrival.
आगमित: आगमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Read over, perused, studied. E. आङ् prefixed to गम in the causal form; participial affix क्त.
आगम्य: आगम्य mfn. (-ग्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 To be approached, accessible. 2 To be acquired. E. आङ् before गम with यत् aff.
आगस्: आगस् n. (-गः) 1 Sin. 2 Transgression, offence, fault. E. आग substituted for इण to go, असुन् Uṇādi aff.
आगाध: आगाध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Very deep: see अगाध.
आगान्तु: आगान्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) A guest: see आगन्तु.
आगामिन्: आगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Arriving, coming. 2 Future. E. आङ् before गम to go, णिनि aff.
आगार: आगार n. (-रं) A house, a dwelling: see अगार.
आगारदाह: आगारदाह m. (-हः) Arson, setting a house on fire. E. आगार and दाह burning.
आगारदाहिन्: आगारदाहिन् m. (-ही) An incendiary. E. आगारदाह arson, and इनि aff.
आगुर्: आगुर् f. (-गूः) An agreement: see आगू.
आगुरब: आगुरब mfn. (-बः-बी-बं) 1 Consisting of or containing Agallochum. 2 Very heavy. E. अगुरु and अण् aff.
आगू: आगू f. (-गूः) 1 An agreement. E. आगम to come, डू affix, or आङ् prefixed to गू to come and क्विन् affix; also आगुर्.
आग्नीध्र: आग्नीध्र n. (-ध्रं) The place where a sacrificial fire is kindled. E. अग्नि fire, and इन्ध to kindle; see अग्नीध्र.
आग्नेय: आग्नेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Belonging or relating to fire or its deity. n. (-यं) 1 The name of a city, (Devikote, on the Coromandel Coast.) 2 Blood. 3 Ghee or boiled butter. m. (-यः) A name of the saint AGASTI. f. (-यी) 1 The wife of AGNI. 2 The southeast quarter, of which AGNI is the regent. E. अग्नि fire or its deity, ढक् affix which leaves ण्य.
आग्रह: आग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Favour, patronage. 2 Seizing, taking. 3 Surpassing, surmounting. 4 Power, ability. E. आङ्, ग्रह to take, अप् aff.
आग्रहायण: आग्रहायण m. (-णः) A month so called, the first of the Hindu year according to some systems, (November-December.) E. अप beginning, and हायन a year; also अग्रहायण, the अ being unchanged.
आग्रहायणिक: आग्रहायणिक m. (-कः) The month Āgrahāyaṇa. E. अग्रहायण and ठक् aff.
आग्रहायणी: आग्रहायणी f. (-णी) 1 The name of a constellation consisting of three stars, one of which is λ Orionis, figured by an antelope's  head, hence also मृगशिरस्. 2 The day of full moon in the month Āgrahāyaṇa. E. अग्रहायण and ङीप् aff.
आग्रायण: आग्रायण n. (-णं) A sacrifice offered when the new rice or wheat ripens. E. अग्र chief, अयन coming, अण् aff.
आग्रायणेष्टि: आग्रायणेष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A particular ceremony: see the last. E. आग्रायण and इष्टि a sacrifice.
आघट्टक: आघट्टक m. (-कः) 1 A tree, (the red sort of Achyranthes.) 2 A rubber, what effects friction. E. आङ् before घदृ and वुन् aff.
आघट्टन: आघट्टन n. (-नं) 1 Friction, rubbing, contact. 2 Shaking. E. आङ् before घदृ to move, ल्युट् aff.
आघट्टित: आघट्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Touched, rubbed. 2 Shaken. E. आङ् before घदृ to move, affix क्त.
आघर्ष: आघर्ष m. (-र्षः) Rubbing, friction. E. आङ् before घृष to rub, affix घञ्.
आघर्षण: आघर्षण n. (-णं) Rubbing, friction. f. (-णी) A brush, a rubber. E. आङ् before घृष to rub, affix ल्युट्.
आघर्षित: आघर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rubbed. E. आङ् before घृष, क्त aff.
आघाट: आघाट m. (-टः) 1 A limit, a boundary. 2 A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.) E. आङ्, घट to endeavour, घञ् aff.
आघात: आघात m. (-तः) 1 Killing, striking. 2 A blow, a wound. 3 A slaughter-house, a place for killing animals or victims. E. आङ्, हन to kill or injure, in the participial form; घ is substituted for ह.
आघातन: आघातन n. (-नं) 1 Striking, killing. 2 A slaughter-house. E. आहन्, ल्युट् aff.
आघार: आघार m. (-रः) 1 Ghee or boiled butter. 2 Sprinkling. 3 Sprinkling ghee at certain sacrifices. E. आङ्, घृ to sprinkle, घञ् aff.
आघूर्णन: आघूर्णन m. (-नं) 1 Rolling, tossing. 2 Whirling. E. आङ् before घूर्ण to roll, affix ल्युट्.
आघूर्णित: आघूर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rolled, rolling. 2 Whirled round. E. आङ् before घूर to roll, affix क्त.
आघोषण: आघोषण n. (-णं) A crying or proclaiming. E. आङ् before घुष to sound, affix ल्युट्.
आघ्नत्: आघ्नत् mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नन्ती-घ्नत्) Striking, beating. E. आङ् before हन to kill, affix शतृ.
आघ्राण: आघ्राण m. (-णः) 1 Smelling. 2 Satisfaction, satiety. E. आङ्, घ्रा to smell, युट् aff.
आघ्रात: आघ्रात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Smelled, scented. 2 Surmounted, surpassed. 3 Satisfied, satiated. E. क्त participial affix after आघ्रा to smell, &c.
आङ्क्षी: आङ्क्षी f. (-ङ्क्षी) A musical instrument, a tabor.
आङ्ग: आङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) 1 Bodily, corporeal. 2 Having limbs or parts, or relating to them. 3 Relating to the inferior persons of a drama, to a portion of the Vedas, &c.: see अङ्ग. m. (-ङ्गः) A soft delicate form or body. E. अङ्ग a body, अण् aff.
आङ्गार: आङ्गार n. (-रं) A multitude of firebrands. E. अङ्गार a torch, अण् aff.
आङ्गक: आङ्गक m. (-कः) 1 The ruler of the country Aṅga. 2 An inhabitant of the same. E. अङ्ग and वुञ् aff.
आङ्गिक: आङ्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Bodily, corporeal. 2 Gesticulated, expressed by bodily action, (dramatic sentiment, passion, &c. exhibited by attitude, gesture, &c.) m. (-कः) A player on a tabor or drum. E. अङ्ग the body, and ठञ् aff.
आङ्गिरस: आङ्गिरस m. (-सः) A name of VṚHASPATI, preceptor of the gods. E. अङ्गिरस् a saint so named, patronymic affix अण्; AṄGIRAS being the father of VṚHASPATI.
आङ्गुलिक: आङ्गुलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Like a finger. E. अङ्गुली and ठक् aff.
आचक्षमाण: आचक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Saying, declaring. E. आङ् before चक्ष to speak, शानच् aff.
आचक्षुस्: आचक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) A learned man, a Paṇḍita. E. आङ्, चक्ष to speak, उमि Uṇādi aff.
आचतुर्य: आचतुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Clumsiness, stupidity. E. अचतुर and यञ aff.
आचतुर्य्य: आचतुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Clumsiness, stupidity. E. अचतुर and यञ aff.
आचम: आचम m. (-मः) Rincing the mouth: see the next.
आचमन: आचमन n. (-नं) 1 Rincing the mouth, sipping water before religious ceremonies, meals, &c. from the palm of the hand, and spitting it out again; the ceremony also includes touching the body in various parts. 2 Gargling the throat, &c. E. आङ् before चमु to eat, युच् aff.
आचमनक: आचमनक m. (-कः) A spitting pot. E. आचमन, वुन् aff.
आचमनीय: आचमनीय n. (-यं) 1 Water for rincing the mouth. 2 A gargle. E. आङ् before चम to eat, affix अनीयर.
आचम्य: आचम्य ind. Having rinced the mouth, having sipped and ejected a little water. E. आङ् before चम to eat, ल्यप् aff.
आचरण: आचरण n. (-णं) 1 Following, observing, usage, practice. 2 An instituted rite or rule of conduct. E. आङ् before चर to go, ल्युट् aff.
आचरणीय: आचरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Right, proper, what is to be followed or observed. E. आङ् before चर to go, अनीयर aff.
आचरत्: आचरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रन्) Following, practising, observing. E. आङ् before चर to go, शतृ aff.
आचरित: आचरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Observed, practised, either as a rite or usuage. 2 Usual, customary. 2 Enjoined, fixed by rule. E. आङ् before चर to go, affix क्त.
आचर्य: आचर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be gone to or approached. E. आङ् before चर to go, यत् aff.
आचर्य्य: आचर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be gone to or approached. E. आङ् before चर to go, यत् aff.
आचान्त: आचान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Sipped and ejected, (as water.) 2 One who has rinced his mouth, &c. E. आङ् before चम to eat, affix क्त.
आचाम: आचाम m. (-मः) Sipping water, rincing the mouth. E. आङ्, चम to eat, affix घज्.
आचाम्य: आचाम्य n. (-म्यं) 1 Rincing the mouth, &c. 2 Water so used. 3 A gargle. E. आङ् before चम to eat, ण्यत् aff.
आचार: आचार m. (-रः) 1 An established rule of conduct, an ordinance, an institute, a precept. 2 Custom, practice, usage. E. आङ्, चर to go, घञ् aff.
आचारबर्ज्जित: आचारबर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Irregular, out of rule. 2 Outcaste. E. आचार an institute, and बर्ज्जित abandoned.
आचारहीन: आचारहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Outcaste, void of decent or established practices. E. आचार and हीन deprived of.
आचारिक: आचारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Conformable to rule or practice. 2 Prescriptive, authorised. E. आचार and ठक् aff.
आचारिन्: आचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Following established rites or practice. E. आचार and इनि aff.
आचार्य: आचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A spiritual guide or teacher; he who invests the student with the sacrificial thread, and instructs him in the Vedas, the law of sacrifice, and religious mysteries. 2 A name of DROṆA, the teacher of the Pāṇḍus. f. (-र्य्या) A spiritual  preceptress. f. (-र्य्यानी) The wife of an Ācārya or holy teacher. E. आङ्, चर to go, ण्यत् affix, in the fem. टाप् or ङीप् with आनुक inserted.
आचार्य्य: आचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A spiritual guide or teacher; he who invests the student with the sacrificial thread, and instructs him in the Vedas, the law of sacrifice, and religious mysteries. 2 A name of DROṆA, the teacher of the Pāṇḍus. f. (-र्य्या) A spiritual  preceptress. f. (-र्य्यानी) The wife of an Ācārya or holy teacher. E. आङ्, चर to go, ण्यत् affix, in the fem. टाप् or ङीप् with आनुक inserted.
आचार्यत्व: आचार्य्यत्व n. (-त्वं) The office or proficiency of a holy teacher. E. आचार्य्य and त्व affix; also with तल्, आचार्य्यता.
आचार्य्यत्व: आचार्य्यत्व n. (-त्वं) The office or proficiency of a holy teacher. E. आचार्य्य and त्व affix; also with तल्, आचार्य्यता.
आचार्योपासन: आचार्य्योपासन n. (-नं) Waiting upon or serving the spiritual preceptor. E. आचार्य्य and उपासना worship.
आचार्य्योपासन: आचार्य्योपासन n. (-नं) Waiting upon or serving the spiritual preceptor. E. आचार्य्य and उपासना worship.
आचित: आचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heaped, accumulated. 2 Covered. 3 Spread, diffused. mn. (-तः-तं) 1 A measure of ten Bharas. 2 A cart load. E. आङ् and the past participle of चिञ् to collect.
आचितिक: आचितिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Holding an Ācita. E. आचित and ठक् aff.
आचितीन: आचितीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Holding or equal to an Ācita. E. आचित and ख aff.
आचूषण: आचूषण n. (-णं) 1 Suction. 2 Application of cupping glasses or horns to the skin, &c. E. आङ्, चूष to suck, ल्युट् aff.
आच्छ: आच्छ r. 1st cl. (इ.) आच्छि (आञ्छति) To lengthen or stretch.
आच्छन्न: आच्छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Covered. 2 Clothed. E. आङ् before च्छद to cover, affix क्त.
आच्छाद: आच्छाद m. (-दः) Cloth, clothes. E. आङ्, छद to cover, घञ् aff.
आच्छादन: आच्छादन n. (-नं) 1 Cloth, clothes. 2 Covering, disappearance. 3 A covering, a sheath, mantle, cloak, &c. E. see the last, affix ल्युट्.
आच्छादित: आच्छादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Covered. 2 Clothed. E. आङ् before छद to cover, affix क्त.
आच्छाद्य: आच्छाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be covered or clothed. ind. Having clothed or put. on. E. आङ् before छद to cover, causal form, यत् or ल्यप् affix; also आच्छादनीय and आच्छादितव्य.
आच्छिन्न: आच्छिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Cut, cut off. E. आङ् before छिद to cut, क्त aff.
आच्छुरित: आच्छुरित n. (-तं) 1 A horse laugh. 2 Making a noise with the finger nails by rubbing them on one another.) E. आङ्, छुर to cut, क्त affix; also आच्छुरितक.
आच्छेद: आच्छेद m. (-दः) Cutting, cutting off, excision. E. आङ् before छिद to cut, घञ् aff.
आच्छेदन: आच्छेदन n. (-नं) Excision. E. आङ्, छिद to cut, ल्युट् aff.
आच्छोदन: आच्छोदन n. (-नं) Hunting, the chase. E. आङ्, चुद to command, with ल्युट् affix, च becomes छ.
आज: आज n. (-जं) Oiled butter. E. आङ्, अज to go, अच् aff.
आजक: आजक n. (-कं) A flock of goats. E. अज a goat, and बञ् aff.
आजकार: आजकार m. (-रः) ŚIVA'S bull. E. आज from अज to go, and कार what makes.
आजगव: आजगव n. (-बं) The bow of ŚIVA. E. see अजकाव.
आजानेय: आजानेय m. (-यः) A horse of a good breed. E. अज to go, घञ् affix, आज going; आनेय to be taken: who carries the rider through all opposition, &c.
आजि: आजि f. (-जिः) 1 War, battle. 2 Level ground. 3 An instant. 4 Abuse, reviling. 5 Going. E. अज to go, इन् Uṇādi affix, and आङ् prefixed or अज with इण् aff.
आजिक्रिया: आजिक्रिया f. (-या) Fighting, making war. E. आजि and क्रिया act.
आजिगीषु: आजिगीषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Ambitious, desirous to excel or overcome. E. आङ् before जि to conquer, in the desiderative form, affix उस.
आजिग्रह: आजिग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) What takes or seizes. E. आङ् before ग्रह to take, श aff.
आजीव: आजीव m. (-वः) Livelihood, subsistence. E. आङ्, जीव to live, घञ् aff.
आजीवन: आजीवन n. (-नं) Livelihood. E. आङ् before जीव to live, ल्युट् aff.
आजीवनार्थ: आजीवनार्थ n. (-र्थं) Means of livelihood or subsistence, business, profession. E. आजीवन and अर्थ means.
आजीव्य: आजीव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Habitable, fertile. 2 To be practised as a means of living. E. आङ् before जीव्य to be lived, in or by.
आजुर्: आजुर् f. (-जूः) Working without wages. E. आङ्, जुर् to become old, क्विप् affix; also आजू.
आजू: आजू f. (-जूः) See the preceding. E. आङ्, जु to be quick, क्विप् affix, and the final lengthened; or जन to be born, and डू aff.
आज्ञप्त: आज्ञप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Ordered, commanded. E. आङ् before ज्ञप causal of ज्ञा and क्त affix; also आज्ञापित.
आज्ञप्ति: आज्ञप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Order, command. E. आङ् before ज्ञा to know, with क्तिन् aff.
आज्ञा: आज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) An order, a command. E. आङ्, ज्ञा to know, and अङ् aff.
आज्ञाकर: आज्ञाकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Obeying, obedient, performing an order. m. (-रः) A servant. E. आज्ञा and कर who makes.
आज्ञाकरण: आज्ञाकरण n. (-णं) Obedience, execution of orders. E. आज्ञा and करण doing.
आज्ञाकारिन्: आज्ञाकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Obedient, ministrant, one who obeys or executes orders. E. आज्ञा and कारिन् who acts.
आज्ञाचक्र: आज्ञाचक्र n. (-क्रं) A mystical circle or diagram, one of six described by the Tantras. E. आज्ञा and चक्र a circle.
आज्ञात: आज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ordered, commanded. E. आङ् before ज्ञा to know, affix क्त.
आज्ञानुयायिन्: आज्ञानुयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Obeying or executing orders, obedient. E. आज्ञा, अनु according to, यायिन् who goes.
आज्ञानुवर्त्तिन्: आज्ञानुवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Obeying or executing orders, E. आज्ञा, अनु according to, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.
आज्ञानुसारिन्: आज्ञानुसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Obedient, obeying or executing orders. E. आज्ञा, अनु according to, सारिन् who goes.
आज्ञापक: आज्ञापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Giving orders, a commander, commanding. E. आङ् before ज्ञा to know, causal form, वुन aff.
आज्ञापत्र: आज्ञापत्र n. (-त्रं) An edict, a written order. E. आज्ञा and पत्र a page.
आज्ञापन: आज्ञापन n. (-नं) Ordering, commanding. E. आङ् before ज्ञा to know, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
आज्ञाप्रतिघात: आज्ञाप्रतिघात m. (-तः) Disobedience, rebellion. E. आज्ञा and प्रति घात rebelling.
आज्ञाभङ्ग: आज्ञाभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Disobedience, insubordination, disloyalty. E. आज्ञा and भङ्ग breaking.
आज्ञावह: आज्ञावह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Obedient, subject, ministrant. E. आज्ञा and वह who bears.
आज्ञासम्पादिन्: आज्ञासम्पादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Obedient, submissive. E. आज्ञा and सम्पादिन् who executes.
आज्यप: आज्यप m. (-पः) A Pitṛ or progenitor of a class of Pitṛs who are the sons of PULASTYA, and the ancestors of the Vaiśya order. E. आज्य ghee, and प who drinks.
आज्यभास: आज्यभास m. (-सः) Offering ghee at certain ceremonies. E. आज्य and भास what shines.
आञ्चन: आञ्चन n. (-नं) Partial extraction of thorns or arrows and the like from the body. आङ् before अञ्च to go, ल्युट् aff.
आञ्जनेय: आञ्जनेय m. (-यः) A name of the monkey HANUMĀN. E. अञ्जना the mother of HANUMĀN, and ढक् patronymic affix which leaves एय.
आञ्जिनेय: आञ्जिनेय m. (-यः) An insect, a kind of lizard. E. अञ्जन antimony, ढक् affix, and इट् inserted; from the blue tint of the animal's back.
आटविक: आटविक m. (-कः) A wood-man. E. अटवी a wood, and ठञ् aff.
आटरूष: आटरूष m. (-षः) A tree, (Justicia adhenatoda, &c.) E. see अटरुष, the अ being made long.
आटि: आटि m. (-टिः) The Śarāli, a bird so called, (Turdus ginginianus.) E. आङ् before अट to go, इन् aff.
आटीकन: आटीकन n. (-नं) The leaping motion of a calf. E. आङ् prefixed to टीक to go, ल्युट् affix; also written आटीकर and आटीलक.
आटीकर: आटीकर m. (-रः) A bull. E. आटीक leaping, and र who gets or uses.
आटोप: आटोप m. (-पः) 1 Pride. 2 Flatulence, borborygmi. E. आङ् before टुप a Sautra root, to be proud, and घञ् aff.
आडम्बर: आडम्बर m. (-रः) 1 Charge sounded by musical instruments. 2 The roaring of elephants. 3 A drum used in battle. 4 Commencement. 5 The eyelid. 6 Pride, arrogance. 7 Anger, passion. 8 Happiness, pleasure. n. (-रं) Rubbing and moulding the body. E. आङ्, दम to tame or subdue, बरच् affix; द is changed to ड.
आडम्बरिन्: आडम्बरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Proud, arrogant. E. आडम्बर and इनि aff.
आडि: आडि f. (-डिः) A bird, the Śarāli, (Turdus ginginianus.) E. आङ्, अड to go, इन् affix; also आटि, आडिका and आटी.
आडू: आडू m. (-डूः) A raft, a float. E. अ neg. अण to sound, ड and ऊ Uṇādi affixes.
आढक: आढक mfn. (-कः-की-का-कं) A measure of grain equal to four Prasthas, or containing nearly 7 lbs. 11 oz. avoirdupois: in Bengal an Araka is equal to two mans or 164 lbs. avds. f. (-की) 1 A kind of pulse, (Cytisus cajan.) 2 A fragrant earth: see तुबरी. E. आङ, ढोक to go, irregularly अच, fem. ङीप्, or टाप with इक inserted.
आढकिक: आढकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Sown with an ĀḌhaka of seed, (a field, &c.) 2 Holding or containing the same. E. आढक the measure, and ठञ् aff.
आढकीन: आढकीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) See the preceding. E. आढक, ख aff.
आढ्य: आढ्य mfn. (-ढ्यः-ढ्या-ढ्यं) 1 Opulent, wealthy, rich. 2 Abounding in, productive. 3 Having, being possessed of. E. आङ्, ध्ये to consider, to meditate, क irregular aff.
आढ्यङ्करण: आढ्यङ्करण n. (-णं) Enriching, or the means of enriching, wealth, prosperity. E. आढ्य and ख्युन् aff.
आढ्यचर: आढ्यचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Formerly opulent. E. आध्य and चरट् aff.
आढ्यम्भविष्णु: आढ्यम्भविष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Becoming rich or eminent. E. आढ्य and भी to be, खिष्णुच् aff.
आढ्यम्भावुक: आढ्यम्भावुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Becoming rich or eminent. E. आढ्य and भू to be, with खुकञ् aff.
आणक: आणक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Low, inferior: see अणक.
आणवीन: आणवीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bearing or fit to bear panic. E. अणु panic, and खञ् aff.
आणि: आणि mf. (-णिः) 1 The edge of a sword. 2 The pin of the axle of a cart. 3 A limit, a boundary. E. अन to sound, इन् affix, the pen. long; also अणि.
आण्ड: आण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A multitude of eggs, &c. E. अण्ड and अण् aff.
आण्डीर: आण्डीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having many eggs, &c. E. आण्ड and ईरच् aff.
आतङ्क: आतङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 Fear, apprehension. 2 Disease, sickness. 3 Affliction, pain. 4 Fever. 5 The sound of a drum or tabor. E. आङ्, तकि to live in distress, घञ aff.
आतञ्चन: आतञ्चन n. (-नं) 1 Calcining, adding a powder or flux to metals in fusion. 2 The flux so used. 3 Casting any thing into another to effect some change, as butter-milk into fresh milk to turn it. 4 Casting away, destroying. 5 Danger, calamity, as a pestilence or epidemic. 6 Speed, velocity. 7 Gratifying, satisfying. E. आङ्, तञ्चु to go, and ल्युट् aff.
आतत: आतत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spread, extended. E. आङ् before तन to spread, क्त aff.
आततायिता: आततायिता f. (-ता) Stealing, persecuting, murdering, destroying. E. आततायिन् and तल् affix; also with त्व affix, आततायित्व.
आततायिन्: आततायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) A felon, a thief, a murderer, incendiary, ravisher, &c. E. आतत extended, every where, ई to go, and णिनि aff.
आतन: आतन n. (-नं) 1 Sight, view. 2 Spreading, expanding. E. आङ् before तन to spread, अच् aff.
आतप: आतप m. (-पः) Sunshine. E. आङ्, तप to heat, to shine, अच् aff.
आतपत्र: आतपत्र n. (-त्रं) A large umbrella of silk or leaves, used in the east as a parasol. E. आतप sun-shine, त्र what preserves.
आतपत्रक: आतपत्रक n. (-कं) A small umbrella, a mat or basket carried on the head as one. E. आतपत्र a parasol, and कन् aff.
आतपवारण: आतपवारण n. (-णं) A Catta or Indian parasol. E. आतप sun-shine, and वारण preventing.
आतपशुष्क: आतपशुष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) Dried in the sun, evaporated by the solar heat. E. आतप and शुष्क dry.
आतपाभाव: आतपाभाव m. (-वः) Shade. E. आतप and अभाव non-existence.
आतर: आतर m. (-रः) Fare, freight. E. आङ्, तृ to cross or pass over, अप् aff.
आतर्पण: आतर्पण n. (-णं) 1 Satisfying, satisfaction. 2 Whitening the wall or floor or seat on festival occasions. E. आङ्, तृप to satisfy or to be satisfied, ल्युट् aff.
आतापिन्: आतापिन् m. (-पी) A kite. E. see the next.
आतायिन्: आतायिन् m. (-यी) A kite. E. आङ् before ताय to spread, णिनि affix; it is also read आतापिन्, from तप to be warm.
आतार: आतार m. (-रः) Fare, freight. E. आङ्, तृ to cross, affix घञ्.
आति: आति m. (-तिः) 1 A bird. 2 Going. E. अत to go, इण् affix: or Uṇādi affix इन्.
आतिथेय: आतिथेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Proper for a guest. 2 Hispitable, attentive to a guest. E. अतिथि a guest, and ढञ् aff.
आतिथ्य: आतिथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) 1 Proper for a guest. 2 Hospitable, attentive to a guest. n. (-थ्यं) Hospitality. m. (-थ्यः) A guest. E. अतिथि and ज्य aff.
आतिरेक्य: आतिरेक्य n. (-क्यं) Excess, superfluity. E. अतिरेक exceeding, ण्यत् aff.
आतिशय्य: आतिशय्य n. (-य्यं) Excess, quantity. E. अतिशय much, and यञ् aff.
आतु: आतु m. (-तुः) A raft, a float. E. आङ्, तृ to cross, and डु aff.
आतुर: आतुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Diseased. E. आङ् before तुर to hasten, क aff.
आतृप्य: आतृप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Satisfiable, to be satisfied. m. (-प्यः) The custard apple tree, (Annona reticulata.) n. (-प्यं) The fruit. E. आङ् before तृप to satisfy, क्यप् aff.
आतोद्य: आतोद्य n. (-द्यं) A musical instrument. E. आङ्, तुद to torment, ण्यत् aff.
आत्त: आत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Taken, accepted. 2 Assumed. 3 Attracted. E. आङ् before दा to give, क्त aff.
आत्तगन्ध: आत्तगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) 1 Humbled, degraded. 2 Perfumed. E. आत्त taken, and गन्ध pride; whose pride is taken down.
आत्तगर्व: आत्तगर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Humbled, &c. see the preceding. E. as before, गर्व्व pride.
आत्तगर्व्व: आत्तगर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Humbled, &c. see the preceding. E. as before, गर्व्व pride.
आत्मकर्मन्: आत्मकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) One's own act. E. आत्मन् and कर्म्म act.
आत्मकर्म्मन्: आत्मकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) One's own act. E. आत्मन् and कर्म्म act.
आत्मकृत: आत्मकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Self-executed, done of one's self. E. आत्मन् and कृत done.
आत्मगुप्ता: आत्मगुप्ता f. (-प्ता) A plant, Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. आत्मन् self, गुप्त hidden; self-preserved.
आत्मग्राहिन्: आत्मग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Selfish, greedy, taking care of one's self, appropriating, taking for one's self. E. आत्मन् and ग्राहिन् who seizes.
आत्मघात: आत्मघात m. (-तः) 1 Suicide. 2 Heresy, schism. E. आत्मन् and घात killing.
आत्मघातिन्: आत्मघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) 1 A suicide. 2 A heretic, a schismatic, one who disregards the moral or religious institutions of the code. E. आत्मन् and घातिन् who kills.
आत्मघोष: आत्मघोष m. (-षः) 1 A crow. 2 A cock. E. आत्मन्, घुषि to sound, and अण् aff.
आत्मज: आत्मज m. (-जः) A son. f. (-जा) 1 A daughter. 2 The understanding. E. आत्मन् the body or soul, and ज born, produced.
आत्मजन्मन्: आत्मजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A son. E. आत्मन् and जन्मन् birth.
आत्मज्ञ: आत्मज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A sage, one who knows his own nature and that of spirit. आत्मन् and ज्ञ who knows.
आत्मज्ञान: आत्मज्ञान n. (-नं) Spiritual knowledge, true wisdom. E. आत्मन् and ज्ञान knowledge.
आत्मगत: आत्मगत ind. (-तं) Apart, to one's self, (in theatrical language.) E. आत्मन् and गत gone.
आत्मतत्व: आत्मतत्व n. (-त्वं) The nature of spirit. E. आत्मन् and तत्व truth.
आत्मतत्वज्ञ: आत्मतत्वज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A sage, especially one versed in the Vedānta doctrines. E. आत्मतत्व and ज्ञ who knows.
आत्मता: आत्मता f. (-ता) 1 Identity with self. 2 Spirituality. E. आत्मन् and तल् affix; also with त्व affix आत्मत्व.
आत्मत्यागिन्: आत्मत्यागिन् m. (-गी) 1 A suicide. 2 A heretic, an unbeliever. E. आत्मन् and त्यागिन् who deserts.
आत्मदर्श: आत्मदर्श m. (-र्शः) A mirror. E. आत्मन् and दर्श sight, seeing.
आत्मदर्शन: आत्मदर्शन n. (-नं) Knowledge of man's real nature, spiritual knowledge. E. आत्मन् and दर्शन seeing.
आत्मद्रोहिन्: आत्मद्रोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Self-tormenting, fretful, miserable. E. आत्मन् and द्रोहिन् who torments.
आत्मन्: आत्मन् m. (-त्मा) 1 The soul. 2 The natural temperament or disposition. 3 BRAHM, the supreme deity and soul of the universe, or more usually in this sense परमात्मा. 4 Life, spirit, the vivifying soul in opposition to the sentient; commonly also जीवात्मा. 5 Body. 6 Care, effort, pains. 7 Firmness. 8 The understanding, the intellect. 9 The mind or faculty of reason. 10 The sun. 11 Fire. 12 Wind, air. 13 A son. 14 The self, the abstract individual. E. आङ्, अत to go, मनिन् Uṇādi aff.
आत्मनीन: आत्मनीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Existent, sentient. 2 Appropriate, good for, fit for. 3 Suitable, (as diet, &c.) m. (-नः) 1 A son. 2 A wife's brother. 3 A jester. E. आत्मन् and ख aff.
आत्मनेपद: आत्मनेपद n. (-दं) The middle voice, the proper form of the verb. E. आत्मने to one's self, पद inflected word.
आत्मबन्धु: आत्मबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) One's own kinsman, a first cousin or father's sister's son, mother's brother's son, mother's sister's son. E. आत्मन् own, and बन्धु relative.
आत्मबुद्धि: आत्मबुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Self-knowledge. 2 One's own knowledge. E. आत्मन् and बुद्धि knowledge.
आत्मबोध: आत्मबोध m. (-धः) Spiritual instruction. E. आत्मन् and बोध causing to know.
आत्मभाव: आत्मभाव m. (-वः) Proper or peculiar nature. E. आत्मन् own, and भाव disposition.
आत्मभू: आत्मभू mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु) Self-born, self-existent. m. (-भूः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 Of KĀMADEVA. 3 Of VIṢṆU. 4 And of ŚIVA. E. आत्मन् self, and भू being.
आत्मभूत: आत्मभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Self-produced. 2 Own, peculiar, belonging to. 3 Attached to, faithful. E. आत्मन् and भूत become.
आत्ममानिन्: आत्ममानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Respecting one's self, decorous, respectable. E. आत्मन् and मानिन् respecting.
आत्ममूली: आत्ममूली f. (-ली) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi:) see दुरालभा. E. आत्मन् and मूल a root.
आत्मम्भरि: आत्मम्भरि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Selfish, greedy. E. आत्मन् self, and भरि who nourishes, from भृ to nourish, with खि aff.
आत्मयाजिन्: आत्मयाजिन् m. (-जी) A wise or learned man, one who studies his own nature and that of the soul. E. आत्मन् and याजिन् who worships.
आत्मयोनि: आत्मयोनि m. (-निः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 Of ŚIVA. 3 Of VIṢṆU, and: 4 Of KĀMADEVA. E. आत्मन् self, and योनि the place of birth: see आत्मभू.
आत्मलोमन्: आत्मलोमन् n. (-म) 1 The beard. 2 The hair of the body. E. आत्मन् and लोमन् hair.
आत्मवत्: आत्मवत् ind. Like one's self. E. आत्मन् and वति aff.
आत्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Prudent, considerate. 3 Selfpossessed, composed, calm. E. आत्मन् and मतुप् aff.
आत्मवत्ता: आत्मवत्ता f. (-त्ता) 1 Self-resemblance. 2 Proportion, analogy. 3 Prudence, self-regard. E. तल् added to the preceding.
आत्मवश: आत्मवश m. (-शः) Subjection of the mind, self-controul, self-government. E. आत्मन् and वश subjection.
आत्मविद्: आत्मविद् m. (-विद्) 1 A sensible man, one who knows himself. 2 A wise man, a sage, one who knows the nature of the soul or spirit. E. आत्मन् and विद् who knows.
आत्मविद्या: आत्मविद्या f. (-द्या) Spiritual knowledge. E. आत्मन् and विद्या science.
आत्मविवृद्धि: आत्मविवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Self-advantage. E. आत्मन् and विवृद्धि encrease.
आत्मवीर: आत्मवीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Existent, sentient. 2 Appropriate, good for one's self. 3 Suitable, (as diet, &c.) m. (-रः) 1 A wife's brother. 2 A jester. E. आत्मन् and बीर heroic, strong.
आत्मवृत्ति: आत्मवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Practising one's duties or occupation. E. आत्मन् and वृत्ति profession.
आत्मशक्ति: आत्मशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Inherent or own power. E. आत्मन् self, and शक्ति power.
आत्मशुद्धि: आत्मशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Self-purification. E. आत्मन् and शुद्धि purity.
आत्मश्लाघा: आत्मश्लाघा f. (-घा) Boasting. E. आत्मन् self, and श्लाघा praise.
आत्मसंयम: आत्मसंयम m. (-मः) Self-restraint, stoicism. E. आत्मन् self, and संयम restraint.
आत्मसन्देह: आत्मसन्देह m. (-हः) Internal doubt. E. आत्मन् and सन्देह doubt.
आत्मसम्भव: आत्मसम्भव m. (-वः) A son. E. आत्मन् and सम्भव birth.
आत्मसात्: आत्मसात् ind. One's own. E. आत्मन् and सात् aff.
आत्मसात्कृत: आत्मसात्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Appropriated, made one's own. E. आत्मसात् and कृत made.
आत्मसिद्धि: आत्मसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Self-advantage. E. आत्मन् and सिद्धि accomplishment.
आत्महत्या: आत्महत्या f. (-त्या) Suicide, self-destruction. E. आत्मन् and हत्या killing.
आत्महन्: आत्महन् m. (-हा) 1 A suicide, a self-murderer. 2 A heretic, an unbeliever. 3 A priest in a temple, a servant or attendant upon an idol. E. आत्मन् and हन् who kills or destroys, self-destroying; the priest subsisting by appropriating to himself offerings to deities, for which future punishment is assigned.
आत्महनन: आत्महनन n. (-नं) Suicide. E. आत्मन् and हनन killing.
आत्महित: आत्महित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Beneficial to one's self. E. आत्मन् and हित good for.
आत्मादिष्ट: आत्मादिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Self-counselled. m. (-ष्टः) A treaty dictated by the party wishing it himself. E. आत्मन् and आदिष्ट directed.
आत्माधीन: आत्माधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sentient, existent. m. (-नः) 1 A wife's brother. 2 A censorious man. 3 A son. E. आत्मन् and अधीन dependant.
आत्मापहारक: आत्मापहारक m. (-कः) An impostor, one who pretends to belong to a higher class than his own. E. आत्मन् and अपहारक a plunderer: who steals himself.
आत्मार्थ: आत्मार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) For one's own sake, for the sake of one's self. E. आत्मन् and अर्थं object.
आत्माशिन्: आत्माशिन् m. (-शी) A fish. E. आत्मन्, अश to eat, णिनि affix; supposed to eat its young.
आत्माश्रय: आत्माश्रय m. (-यः) 1 Self-dependance. 2 Innate idea, abstract knowledge, independant of the thing to be known. E. आत्मन् self, and आश्रय asylum.
आत्मीय: आत्मीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Cognate, related, of kin. 2 Own. E. आत्मन् and छण् aff.
आत्मोदय: आत्मोदय m. (-यः) Self-advantage or elevation. E. आत्मन् and उदय rising.
आत्मोपम: आत्मोपम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Like one's self. E. आत्मन् and उपम resemblance.
आत्मोपजीविन्: आत्मोपजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) 1 A public performer, actor, singer, dancer, &c. 2 A day labourer. E. आत्मन् self, उपजीविन् who subsists: who lives by his own exertions.
आत्मोद्भव: आत्मोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced from one's self. m. (-वः) A son. f. (-वा) 1 A daughter. 2 A plant, (Glycine debilis.) E. आत्मन् and उद्भव born.
आत्यन्तिक: आत्यन्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Supreme. 2 Excessive, abundant. 3 Infinite. E. अत्यन्त exceeding, ठक् aff.
आत्ययिक: आत्ययिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Ill-omened, unpropitious. 2 Destructive. 3 Disastrous. 4 Distressing, painful. E. अत्यय destruction. ठञ् aff.
आत्यूह: आत्यूह m. (-हः) A gallinule: see दात्यूह.
आत्रेय: आत्रेय m. (-यः) 1 The name of a Muni or saint, the son of ATRI, applicable to DATTA, DURVĀSAS, and SOMA. 2 An essential humor or juice of the body. f. (-यिका or -यी) A woman during her courses. f. (-यी) 1 The name of a river in the north of Bengal. 2 The wife of ATRI. 3 Any woman of the Brahmanical. order. E. अत्रि a saint so called, ढक् patronymic aff.
आथर्वण: आथर्व्वण m. (-णः) 1 A family priest. 2 A Brahman versed in the Atharvan Veda. n. (-णं) 1 A collection of prayers, &c. delivered by ATHARVAN, a sage. 2 A private apartment in which, after a sacrifice, the sacrificer receives absolution from the officiating Brahman. E. अथर्व्वण a Veda, and अण् aff.
आथर्व्वण: आथर्व्वण m. (-णः) 1 A family priest. 2 A Brahman versed in the Atharvan Veda. n. (-णं) 1 A collection of prayers, &c. delivered by ATHARVAN, a sage. 2 A private apartment in which, after a sacrifice, the sacrificer receives absolution from the officiating Brahman. E. अथर्व्वण a Veda, and अण् aff.
आथर्वणिक: आथर्व्वणिक m. (-कः) A Brahman who has studied the Atharva Veda. E. अथर्व्वण and ठक् aff.
आथर्व्वणिक: आथर्व्वणिक m. (-कः) A Brahman who has studied the Atharva Veda. E. अथर्व्वण and ठक् aff.
आदत्त: आदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Taken, received. E. आङ् before दा, क्त aff.
आददान: आददान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Taking, accepting. E. आङ् before दा to give, affix शानच्.
आदधान: आदधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having, possessing. E. आङ् before धा to have, शानच् aff.
आदर: आदर m. (-रः) 1 Respect, reverence. 2 Commencement, beginning. E. आङ्, दृ to have, अप् aff.
आदरणीय: आदरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Venerable, respectable. 2 To be attended to. E. आङ् before दृ to have, आनीयर् aff.
आदर्तव्य: आदर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be respected or regarded. E. आङ् ट्ट and तव्य aff.
आदर्त्तव्य: आदर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be respected or regarded. E. आङ् ट्ट and तव्य aff.
आदर्य: आदर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Venerable, respectable. E. आङ् before दृ to have, यत् aff.
आदर्य्य: आदर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Venerable, respectable. E. आङ् before दृ to have, यत् aff.
आदर्श: आदर्श m. (-र्शः) 1 A mirror. 2 A commentary. 3 The original manuscript from which a copy is taken. E. आङ्, दृशि to see, घञ् aff.
आदर्शन: आदर्शन n. (-नं) 1 Showing, making apparent or seen. 2 A mirror. E. आङ् before दृश to see, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
आदर्शित: आदर्शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shewn, made apparent. E. आङ् before दृश to see, causal form, क्त aff.
आदान: आदान n. (-नं) 1 Taking, receipt, acceptance. 2 A horse's trappings. 3 A symptom. f. (-नी) A plant: see हस्तिघोषा. E. आङ् reversing the sense, and दा to give, ल्युट् affix, fem. ङीप्.
आदाय: आदाय ind. Having taken. E. आङ् before दा to give, ल्यप् aff.
आदायचर: आदायचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who goes away after taking any thing. E. आदाय, चर to go, ट aff.
आदि: आदि m. only. (-दिः) 1 First, prior. 2 First, pre-eminent. ind. (In composition,) Other, et-cetera, as स्वादि the affix सु et-cetera. E. आङ् before दा to give, and कि aff.
आदिकर: आदिकर m. (-रः) BRAHMĀ, the creator. E. आदि and कर who makes.
आदिकर्तृ: आदिकर्त्तृ m. (-त्ता) BRAHMĀ, as the creator. E. आदि and कर्त्तृ who makes.
आदिकर्त्तृ: आदिकर्त्तृ m. (-त्ता) BRAHMĀ, as the creator. E. आदि and कर्त्तृ who makes.
आदिकवि: आदिकवि m. (-विः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 A name of VĀLMĪKI, the first mortal poet. E. आदि the first, and कवि a poet.
आदिकारण: आदिकारण n. (-णं) A primary cause. E. आदि and कारण a cause.
आदितस्: आदितस् ind. From the first, from the beginning. E. आदि and तसि aff.
आदितेय: आदितेय m. (-यः) A deity, a divinity. E. अदिति the mother of the gods, and ढक् derivative aff.
आदित्य: आदित्य m. (-त्यः) 1 A deity in general. 2 A deity of a particular class; the ĀDITYAS are twelve in number, they are forms of SŪRYA or the sun, and appear to represent him as distinct in each month of the year. 3 The sun. E. अदिति the mother of the gods, and घञ् derivative aff.
आदित्यपुष्पिका: आदित्यपुष्पिका f. (-का) Red swallow wort. E. आदित्य the sun, and पुष्पिका having a flower, the flower of the sun, from its red colour: see अर्कपुष्पिका.
आदित्यमण्डल: आदित्यमण्डल n. (-लं) The disc or orb of the sun. E. आदित्य and मण्डल a circle.
आदित्यसूनु: आदित्यसूनु m. (-नुः) 1 A name of SUGRĪVA, a monkey king; 2 of YAMA; 3 of SANI or SATURN. E. आदित्य the sun, and सूनु a son.
आदित्व: आदित्व n. (-त्वं) Priority, precedence. E. आदि and त्व added; also आदिता with तल् aff.
आदित्सिता: आदित्सिता f. (-ता) Wish to seize. E. आङ् before दा to give, desiderative form, क्त aff.
आदित्सु: आदित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing to take or have. E. आङ् before दा to give, desiderative form, उस् aff.
आदिदेव: आदिदेव m. (-वः) Name of VIṢṆU or NĀRĀYAṆA. E. आदि the first, and देव a god, the first god, the creator.
आदिपुरुष: आदिपुरुष m. (-षः) The first male, usually applied to VIṢṆU. E. आदि the first, and पुरुष a man.
आदिभूत: आदिभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) First born or existent. m. (-तः) BRAHMA. E. आदि and भूत been.
आदिम: आदिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) First, prior. E. आदि and डिमच् aff.
आदिराज: आदिराज m. (-जः) The name of a king; also पृथु. E. आदि and राजन् a king, the first king; he was a form of VIṢṆU, and husband of Pṛthvī or the earth.
आदिवराह: आदिवराह m. (-हः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. आदि and वराह a boar; the first boar, alluding to VIṢṆU'S avatāra, or incarnation in that form; also similar compounds, as आदिशूकरः, आद्यकोलः, &c.
आदिष्ट: आदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Commanded, directed. 2 Appointed. 3 Advised, enjoined. 4 Said. n. (-ष्टं) Fragments or leavings of a meal. E. आङ्, दिश to point or shew, क्त aff.
आदिष्टिन्: आदिष्टिन् m. (-ष्टी) 1 A student, a Brahman in the first order. 2 A penitent, one engaged in any expiatory rite. E. आदिष्ट what is instructed, and इनि aff.
आदीनव: आदीनव m. (-वः) 1 Distress, pain, uneasiness. 2 Fault, transgression. 3 An inflictor of distress. E. आङ्, दीङ् to decay, deriv. irr.
आदीपन: आदीपन n. (-नं) 1 Whitening the wall, floor, or seat, &c. upon festival occasions. 2 Embellishing. 3 Inflaming, exciting. E. आङ्, दीप to beautify, ल्युट् aff.
आदीपित: आदीपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Illuminated. E. आङ् before दीप to inflame, क्त aff.
आदृत: आदृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Respectful. 2 Respected, honoured, worshipped. 3 Zealous, diligent. E. आङ् before दृञ् to have, and क्त aff.
आदृत्य: आदृत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Venerable, respectable. E. आङ् before दृ to have, क्यप् affix; तुक् augment.
आदेय: आदेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Receivable, leviable, what may be taken or received. E. आङ् before दा to give, यत् aff.
आदेवक: आदेवक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) One who sports or plays. E. आङ्, दिन to sport, वुञ् aff.
आदेश: आदेश m. (-शः) 1 An order, a command. 2 Advice, instruction. 3 (In grammar,) A substitute; 4 (In astrology,) Event, result, consequence of stellar conjunctions, &c. E. आङ्, दिश to point or shew, घञ् aff.
आदेशिन्: आदेशिन् m. (-शी) 1 A commander, a director. 2 An astrologer, a fortune teller. E. आङ्, दिश to point or shew, and णिनि aff.
आदेष्टृ: आदेष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) 1 An adviser, a director, a commander. 2 An employer of priests. E. आङ्, दिश to shew, तृच् aff.
आद्य: आद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 First, initial. 2 Edible, what is to be or may be eaten. n. (-द्यं) 1 Grain. 2 Food. f. (-द्या) A name of DURGĀ. E. आदि and ण्यत् affix, fem. टाप्.
आद्यकवि: आद्यकवि m. (-विः) A name of VĀLMĪKI, author of the Rāmāyaṇa. E. आद्य first, and कवि a poet, being the first who wrote Sansscrit verse.
आद्यन्त: आद्यन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) From the beginning to the end. n. (-न्तं) Beginning and end, first and last. E. आदि first, and अन्त last.
आद्यन्तवत्: आद्यन्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Finite, having beginning and end. E. आदि beginning, अन्त end, and मतुप् aff.
आद्यमाषक: आद्यमाषक m. (-कः) A Māṣa, a weight equal to five Gunja or Ratti seeds, about 17(1/2) grains troy. E. आद्य and माषक a Māṣa, the primary Māṣa; also माष and मास.
आद्यवीज: आद्यवीज n. (-जं) A primary cause. E. आद्य and वीज seed, cause.
आद्यून: आद्यून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Shamelessly voracious. 2 Without the beginning. E. आङ्, दिव to play or enjoy in the part. past, or आदि first, and ऊन minus.
आद्योपान्त: आद्योपान्त adv. (-न्तं) From first to last. E. आद्य and उप near, अन्त end.
आधर्मिक: आधर्म्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Unjust, unrighteous. E. अ neg. धर्म्म virtue, &c. ठक् aff.
आधर्म्मिक: आधर्म्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Unjust, unrighteous. E. अ neg. धर्म्म virtue, &c. ठक् aff.
आधर्षण: आधर्षण n. (-नं) 1 Conviction, (of crime or of error.) 2 Sentence, refutation. 2 Injuring, annoying. E. आङ् before धृष to be bold, ल्युट् aff.
आधर्षत: आधर्षत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Convicted, sentenced. 2 Refuted, disproved. 3 Injured, aggrieved. E. आङ् before धृष to be bold, affix क्त.
आधान: आधान n. (-नं) 1 Taking, having. 2 Receiving, recovering. 3 A ceremony performed with consecrated fire. 4 A pledge, a deposit. 5 A surety. 6 A ceremony performed previous to conception: see गर्भाधान. E. आङ्, धा to have, affix ल्युट्.
आधानिक: आधानिक n. (-कं) A ceremony performed after cohabitation to procure or favour conception. E. आधान and ठक् affix: see the preceding.
आधाय: आधाय ind. Having deposited or placed. E. आङ् before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
आधार: आधार m. (-रः) 1 Support, prop, stay. 2 Receptacle. 3 Comprehension, location, the sense of the ablative in or on. 4 A dike, a canal. 5 A basin round the foot of a tree. E. आङ् and धृ to hold or contain, घञ् aff.
आधाराधेयभाव: आधाराधेयभाव m. (-वः) The influence or action of the support or recipient upon the thing received or supported. E. आधार support, &c. आधेय what is to be held, and भाव quality.
आधि: आधि m. (-धिः) 1 Mental agony, anxiety. 2 Expectation. 3 Definition. 4 A pledge, a pawn, a mortgage. 5 Location, fixing, site, &c. 6 Engagement. E. आङ्, ध्यै to reflect, and कि aff.
आधिक्य: आधिक्य n. (-क्यं) Excess. E. अधिक more, ष्यज aff.
आधिज: आधिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by pain, &c. E. आधि pain, and ज produced.
आधिज्ञ: आधिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Crooked. 2 Pained, distressed. E. आधि pain, &c. and ज्ञ who knows.
आधिकारण्य: आधिकारण्य n. (-ण्यं) 1 Possession. 2 Location. E. अधिकरण्य, and ष्यञ् aff.
आधिकारिक: आधिकारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Supreme, superior, relating or belonging to any thing or person of importance or sway. 2 Official, relating to any office or duty. E. अधिकार and ठञ् aff.
आधित्व: आधित्व n. (-त्वं) Nature or circumstance of a pledge. E. आधि and त्व aff.
आधित्वोपाधि: आधित्वोपाधि m. (-धिः) The object or purpose with which a pledge is given, the conditions or terms of a mortgage. E. आधित्व and उपाधि condition.
आधिदैविक: आधिदैविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to, a tutelary or presiding deity. E. अधिदैव and ठञ् aff.
आधिपत्य: आधिपत्य n. (-त्यं) Power, supremacy, sovereignty. E. अधिपति a lord or master, &c. व्यञ् aff.
आधिभोग: आधिभोग m. (-गः) Usufruct, enjoyment or use of a deposit, use of a horse, cow, &c. pledged. E. आधि a pledge, and भोग enjoyment.
आधिभौतिक: आधिभौतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Elementary, derived or produced from the primitive elements. E. अधिभूत a material cause, ठञ् aff.
आधिमन्यव: आधिमन्यव m. (-वः) Feverish heat or burning. E. आधि and मन्यु distress, अण् aff.
आधिराज्य: आधिराज्य n. (-ज्यं) Supreme sway, royalty, royal government. E. अधिराज and ष्यञ् aff.
आधिवेदनिक: आधिवेदनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Property, &c. given to a first wife upon marrying a second. E. अधि before विद to know, and ल्युट् affix, अधिवेदन, ठक् aff.
आधीकरण: आधीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Pledging, mortgaging. 2 A pledge. E. आधि and करण making, &c. with च्चि inserted.
आधीकृत: आधीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pledged, pawned, mortgaged. E. आधि and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
आधीकृत्य: आधीकृत्य ind. Having pledged. E. आधि with कृत्य having done, च्चि augment.
आधुत: आधुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, trembling. E. आङ् before धु or धू to tremble, affix क्त; it is also long, आधूत.
आधुनिक: आधुनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) New, recent, of the present moment. E. अधुना now, and ठक् aff.
आधूत: आधूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, agitated, trembling. E. आङ् before धूत shaken.
आधूर्य: आधूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Weakness, infirmity. E. अ neg. धुर्य्य to be borne, अण aff.
आधूर्य्य: आधूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Weakness, infirmity. E. अ neg. धुर्य्य to be borne, अण aff.
आधृत: आधृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Contained, supported. E. आङ् before धृ to have, क्त aff.
आधेय: आधेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Placed, deposited or to be deposited. 2 To be received or supported. 3 To be pledged or mortgaged. E. आङ्, धा to have or hold, and यत् aff.
आधोरण: आधोरण m. (-णः) The rider or driver of an elephant. E. आङ् धोर to move well, ल्युट् aff.
आध्मात: आध्मात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sounded, sounding. 2 Inflated. 3 Burnt. m. (-तः) 1 Flatulence, borborygmi, swelling of the abdomen with noise. 2 War, battle. E. आङ् before ध्मा to blow, affix क्त.
आध्मान: आध्मान n. (-नं) 1 Blowing, inflation. 2 A bellows. 3 Intumescence, swelling of the belly, dropsy. E. आङ् before ध्मा to blow, and ल्युट् aff.
आध्या: आध्या f. (-ध्या) Recollection, remembering especially with regret. E. आङ् before ध्यै to reflect, अच् affix, and ठाप् fem.
आध्यात्मिक: आध्यात्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the supreme spirit, spiritual, holy. E. अध्यात्म the soul, and ठङ् aff.
आध्यान: आध्यान n. (-नं) Remembering, pensive or sorrowful recollection, dwelling or meditating upon, &c. E. आङ्, ध्यै to consider, and ल्युट् aff.
आध्यापक: आध्यापक m. (-कः) A teacher, a scriptural preceptor. E. आङ्, prefixed to the causal of अधी to peruse, affix वुन्.
आध्युपभोग: आध्युपभोग m. (-गः) Usufruct of a pledge. E. आधि and उपभोग enjoyment.
आध्वर्यव: आध्वर्य्यव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Belonging, to the officiating priest. E. अध्वर्य्यु and अञ् aff.
आध्वर्य्यव: आध्वर्य्यव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Belonging, to the officiating priest. E. अध्वर्य्यु and अञ् aff.
आन: आन m. (-नः) Breath inspired. E. अन् to be, अण् affix; existing by it.
आनक: आनक m. (-कः) 1 A large military drum, beaten at one end. 2 A double drum. 3 A small drum or tabor. 4 A thunder-cloud. or a cloud to which the noise of the thunder is ascribed. E. आङ्, अन to sound, and वुन् aff.
आनकटुन्दुभि: आनकटुन्दुभि m. (-भिः) A name of VASUDEVA the father of KṚṢṆA. E. अनकदुन्दभ the parent of VASUDEVA, इञ् aff.
आनकदुन्दुभि: आनकदुन्दुभि mf. (-भिः-भी) A large drum beaten at one end, a large dhol, a kettle drum. E. आनक what sounds, and दुन्दुभि a drum.
आनक्य: आनक्य m. (-क्यः) Name of a Muni or sage: see काण्डिल्य.
आनत: आनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bending, stooping, bowed. 2 Pacified, conciliated. 3 Humbled. 4 Submissive, obedient. E. आङ् before नम to bow or bend, affix क्त.
आनति: आनति f. (-तिः) Bending, bowing, stooping. E. आङ् before नम to bow, क्तिन् aff.
आनद्ध: आनद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Bound, tied. 2 Costive. n. (-द्धं) 1 A drum in general: also अवनद्ध. 2 Dressing, putting on clothes or ornaments. E. आङ्, नह to bind, and क्त aff.
आनन: आनन n. (-नं) The mouth, (and by syncope) the face. E. आङ् before अन to live or breathe, ल्युट् aff.
आनन्तर्य: आनन्तर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Proximity, absence of interval. 2 Immediate consequence or succession. E. अनन्तर and यञ् aff.
आनन्तर्य्य: आनन्तर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Proximity, absence of interval. 2 Immediate consequence or succession. E. अनन्तर and यञ् aff.
आनन्त्य: आनन्त्य n. (-न्त्यं) 1 Infinity. 2 Immortality, future happiness. E. अनन्त endless, यञ् aff.
आनन्द: आनन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 Happiness, joy. 2 BALARĀMA according to the Jain system of many KṚṢṆAS and many BALARĀMAS. n. (-न्दं) GOD, Supreme Spirit, according to the Vedānta. f. (-न्दी) A  plant, vulgarly Ākanpāta. E. आङ्, नदि to be or make happy घञ् aff.
आनन्दथु: आनन्दथु mfn. (-थुः-थुः-थु) Happy, joyful. m. (-थुः) Happiness, joy. E. आङ्, नदि, to be happy, and अथुच् aff.
आनन्दद: आनन्दद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Exhilarating, delighting: so आनन्दकर.
आनन्दन: आनन्दन n. (-नं) 1 Civility, courtesy, the treatment of a friend or guest at meeting and parting. 2 Delighting, making happy. 3 What gives or occasions delight. E. आङ् before नदि to make happy, and ल्युट् aff.
आनन्दपट: आनन्दपट n. (-टं) Bridal clothes. E. आनन्द making happy, and पट cloth.
आनन्दप्रभव: आनन्दप्रभव m. (-वः) The seminal fluid. E. आनन्द pleasure, and प्रभव what is manifest.
आनन्दमय: आनन्दमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Blissful, made up or consisting of happiness. n. (-यं) The Supreme Spirit. E. आनन्द and मयट् aff.
आनन्दमयकोष: आनन्दमयकोष m. (-षः) The innermost case of the body, or causal frame enshrining the soul. E. आनन्दमय and कोष sheath.
आनन्दि: आनन्दि m. (-न्दिः) Happiness, pleasure; also आनन्दी f. (-न्दी.) E. आङ्, नदि to be happy, and कि aff.
आनन्दित: आनन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Happy, rejoiced, delighted. E. आङ् before नदि, affix क्त.
आनन्दिन्: आनन्दिन् mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि) Happy, joyful. E. आनन्द and इनि aff.
आनमित: आनमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bent, bowed down. E. आङ् before नम with क्त aff.
आनम्र: आनम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) Bowing, stooping, bent, bowed down. E. आङ् before नम to bow, रक् aff.
आनय: आनय m. (-यः) 1 Bringing. 2 Investiture with the sacred thread. E. आङ्, णीञ् to obtain, अच् aff.
आनयन: आनयन n. (नं) 1 Bringing. 2 Investiture with the sacred thread. E. आङ् before णी to get, affix ल्युट्.
आनर्त: आनर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 A country on the north of the Malabar Coast. 2 A stage, a theatre. 3 War. 4 Water. 5 An inhabitant of Ānarta. E. आङ् before नृत् to dance, aff. घञ्.
आनर्त्त: आनर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 A country on the north of the Malabar Coast. 2 A stage, a theatre. 3 War. 4 Water. 5 An inhabitant of Ānarta. E. आङ् before नृत् to dance, aff. घञ्.
आनर्थक्य: आनर्थक्य n. (-क्यं) 1 Unfitness, impropriety. 2 Uselessness, unprofitableness. E. अनर्थ unprofitable, ष्यञ् aff.
आनाय: आनाय m. (-यः) A net. E. आङ् before णीञ् to obtain, घञ् aff.
आनाय्य: आनाय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) To be brought. m. (-य्यः) Consecrated fire, taken from the household fire, and placed on the south side. E. आङ् before णी to obtain, ण्यत् affix: deriv. irregular.
आनाह: आनाह m. (-हः) 1 Epistasis, suppression of urine, or constipation. 2 Length, especially of cloth. E. आङ्, नह to bind, affix घञ.
आनिल: आनिल m. (-लः) Name of HANUMĀN and BHĪMA. E. अनिल and अण् patronymic affix; see the next.
आनिलि: आनिलि m. (-लिः) 1 A name of the monkey HANUMĀN. 2 BHĪMA. E. अनिल the wind, patronymic affix इञ; HANUMĀN and BHĪMA being the sons of ANILA or the wind. f. (-ली) A name of SVĀTI, the fifteenth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion. E. अनिल and अण् affix fem. ङीप्; ANILA being the ruling deity of the asterism.
आनीत: आनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken. 2 Brought. 3 Obtained. E. आङ् before णी and क्त aff.
आनीय: आनीय ind. 1 Having taken. 2 Having brought. E. आङ् before णी and ल्यप् aff.
आनील: आनील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Darkish. m. (-लः) A black horse. E. आङ् diminutive, and नील black or dark blue.
आनुकूल्य: आनुकूल्य n. (-ल्यं) Favour, kindness. E. अनुकूल favourable, ष्यञ् aff.
आनुगत्य: आनुगत्य n. (-त्यं) Acquaintance, familiarity. E. अनुगत followed, ष्यञ् aff.
आनुग्रामिक: आनुग्रामिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) About or belonging to the village, rustic, rural, &c. E. अनुग्राम and ठञ् aff.
आनुपदिक: आनुपदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Following, pursuing, tracking. E. अनुपद and ठञ् aff.
आनुपूर्व: आनुपूर्व्व nf. (-र्व्वं-र्व्वी) 1 Order, series, succession. 2 (In law) Direct order of the castes. (In logic) A conclusion, regularly or syllogistically deduced. E. अनु subsequent, पूर्व्व first, अण् affix; also आनुपूर्व्व्य and आनुपूर्व्वक.
आनुपूर्व्व: आनुपूर्व्व nf. (-र्व्वं-र्व्वी) 1 Order, series, succession. 2 (In law) Direct order of the castes. (In logic) A conclusion, regularly or syllogistically deduced. E. अनु subsequent, पूर्व्व first, अण् affix; also आनुपूर्व्व्य and आनुपूर्व्वक.
आनुमानिक: आनुमानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Inferrable, inferred, subject to inference, derived from inference, &c. E. अनुमान inference, and ठञ् aff.
आनुरक्ति: आनुरक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Passion, affection. E. अनुरक्ति the same, the first vowel made long.
आनुलोम्य: आनुलोम्य n. (-म्यं) Direct order, regular series or succession. E. अनुलोम direct, and यञ् aff.
आनुलोमिक: आनुलोमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Regular, orderly, in due course or series. E. आनुलोम and ठञ् aff.
आनुविधित्सा: आनुविधित्सा f. (-सा) Ingratitude. E. अनु and वि before धा, to have, desiderative form, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
आनुषङ्गिक: आनुषङ्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Proportionate, like, analogous, relative. 2 Necessary, (as result, consequence.) 3 Connected, concomitant with, adherent, inherent. 4 (In grammar) Elliptical, including or agreeing with words not comprised in the sentence. E. अनुषङ्ग relation or connexion, ठञ् aff.
आनूप: आनूप m. (-पः) Any animal frequenting marshy places, as a buffalo, &c. E. अनूप marshy ground, and अण् aff.
आनूपमांस: आनूपमांस m. (-सः) Flesh or meat of animals frequenting marshes, &c. E. आनूप and मांस flesh.
आनृण्य: आनृण्य n. (-ण्यं) Acquittance of debt or obligation. E. अनृणी out of debt, ण्यत् aff.
आनृशंस्य: आनृशंस्य n. (-स्यं) 1 Mildness. 2 Cruelty. E. अनृशंस mild, and यञ् affix, or आङ् intensitive, and नृशंस्य cruelty.
आनेतव्य: आनेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be brought or taken. E. आङ् before णी to take, तव्य aff.
आनेय: आनेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be taken or brought. E. आङ् before णी to take, ण्यत् aff.
आनैपुण: आनैपुण n. (-णं) Clumsiness, stupidity. E. अनिपुण not dexterous, अण् affix; and the initial optionally long.
आनैश्वर्य: आनैश्वर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Absence of power or supremacy. E. अनैश्वर्य्य the same, and the initial optionally long.
आनैश्वर्य्य: आनैश्वर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Absence of power or supremacy. E. अनैश्वर्य्य the same, and the initial optionally long.
आन्त: आन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Gone. E. अम to go, क्त aff.
आन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) Final, terminal, relating to the end. E. अन्त and अण् aff.
आन्तर्गणिक: आन्तर्गणिक mf. (-कः-की-कं) Included, comprehended, (in a class or troop.) E. अन्तर् and गण a class, ठञ् aff.
आन्तरीक्ष: आन्तरीक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Heavenly, celestial, produced in the sky. n. (-क्षं) The firmament. E. अन्तरीक्ष the same, and अण् aff.
आन्तर्वेश्मिक: आन्तर्वेश्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Produced or occuring within a house. E. अन्तर्वेश्मन् and ठञ् aff.
आन्तिका: आन्तिका f. (-का) An elder sister: see अन्तिका.
आन्त्रिक: आन्त्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Visceral, relating to the bowels. E. अन्त्र an entrail, and ठक् aff.
आन्दोल: आन्दोल r. 10th cl. (त) आन्दोलयति To swing.
आन्दोल m. (-लः) Swinging. E. आन्दोल and घञ् aff.
आन्दोलन: आन्दोलन n. (-नं) 1 Swinging. 2 A swing. 3 Trembling, oscillation. E. आन्दोल to swing, ल्युट् aff.
आन्दोलित: आन्दोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Swung, shaken. E. participle past of आन्दोल.
आन्धस: आन्धस m. (-सः) The scum of boiled rice. E. अन्धस and अण् aff.
आन्धसिक: आन्धसिक m. (-कः) A cook. E. अन्धस् boiled rice, and ठक् aff.
आन्न: आन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्नी-न्नं) 1 Fed, having food. 2 Relating to food, derived from it, &c. E. अन्न and अण् aff.
आन्ध्र: आन्ध्र m. (-न्ध्रः) A native of Telangana. E. अन्ध्र country, अण् aff.
आन्वयिक: आन्वयिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of a good family, well born. 2 Orderly, according to order or arrangement. E. अन्वय race, ठक् aff.
आन्वीक्षिकी: आन्वीक्षिकी f. (-की) Logical philosophy, metaphysics. E. अनु according to, ईक्ष to see, ठक् aff.
आप: आप r. 1st, 5th & 10th cls. (ऌ.) आपॢ (आपति, आप्नोति or -नुते and आपयति) 1 To pervade or occupy. 2 To obtain, to gain. In the first sense it is usually employed with वि prefixed, and in the second with अव or प्र; also with अभि and वि prefixed, to spread from one place to another; with परि and वि or सं and वि, to obtain completely; with सं and प्र, to meet with, light upon or fall into; with उप, सं and प्र, to arrive at, to enter.
आप m. (-पः) One of the eight demigods called Vasus. E. आप् to obtain, अच् aff.
आपकर: आपकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Offensive, mischievous, unfriendly. E. अपकर offence, अञ् aff.
आपक्व: आपक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) 1 Half baked, crude, raw. 2 Nearly ripe, not quite ripe. 3 Undressed, what is eaten without further preparation, (as bread, &c.) E. आङ् diminutive, पक्व dressed, cooked.
आपगा: आपगा f. (-गा) A river, a stream. E. आप् a quantity of water, the ocean, and गा fem. derivative from गम to go.
आपण: आपण m. (-णः) 1 A market. 2 A shop. E. आङ् and पण to trade, affix अच्.
आपणिक: आपणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mercantile, relating to traffic, to a market, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A merchant, a dealer, a shop-keeper. 2 Tax on markets or shops 3 Assize, market rate. E. आङ् पणि to negociate, इकण् Uṇādi affix; or आपण and ठक् aff.
आपतन: आपतन n. (-नं) 1 Coming, approaching. 2 Descending, alighting. 3 Happening. E. आङ् before पत to go, affix ल्युट्.
आपतिक: आपतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Accidental, unforeseen, sent from heaven. m. (-कः) A hawk, a falcon. E. आङ्, पत to go, to fall, इकन् Uṇādi aff.
आपतित: आपतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Happened, befallen. 2 Alighted, descended. E. आङ् before पत to go, affix क्त.
आपत्काल: आपत्काल m. (-लः) Season of distress. E. आपद् and काल time.
आपत्कालिक: आपत्कालिक mfn. (-कः-की-का-कं) Occurring in a time of calamity, belonging to it. E. आपत्काल and ठक or ञिठ् aff.
आपत्ति: आपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Misfortune, calamity. 2 Obtaining, procuring. 3 Fault, transgression. 2 Remonstrance, expostulation. E. आङ्, पद to go, क्तिन् aff.
आपत्प्राप्त: आपत्प्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Unfortunate, unhappy, afflicted. E. आपद् misfortune, and प्राप्त obtained.
आपद्: आपद् f. (पद्-पत्) Misfortune, calamity. E. आङ्, पद to go, क्किप् aff.
आपद्ग्रस्त: आपद्ग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Unfortunate, unhappy, in misfortune. E. आपद् and ग्रस्त seized.
आपद्धर्म: आपद्धर्म्म n. (-र्म्मं) Practice or profession other than that proper to caste, but allowable in time of distress. E. आपद and धर्म्म virtue.
आपद्धर्म्म: आपद्धर्म्म n. (-र्म्मं) Practice or profession other than that proper to caste, but allowable in time of distress. E. आपद and धर्म्म virtue.
आपदा: आपदा fn. (-दा-दं) Misfortune, calamity. E. आङ्, पद to go, अङ् and टाप्; also आपद्.
आपन: आपन n. (-नं) 1 Obtaining. 2 Pepper. E. आप to obtain, ल्युट् aff.
आपनिक: आपनिक m. (-कः) 1 An emerald. 2 A barbarian. E. आङ्, पन to praise, and इकन् Uṇādi aff.
आपन्न: आपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Unfortunate, afflicted. 2 Gained, obtained, acquired. E. आङ्, पद to go, क्त participial aff.
आपन्नसत्व: आपन्नसत्व mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं) Impregnated, pregnant. f. (-त्वा) A pregnant woman. E. आपन्न obtained, सत्व thing, substance, टाप् aff.
आपमित्यक: आपमित्यक n. (-कं) Property, &c. obtained by barter. E. अपमित्य having changed, ककन aff.
आपराह्निक: आपराह्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Occurring in the afternoon, &c. E. अपराह्न and ठञ् aff.
आपव: आपव m. (-वः) A name of VASIṢṬHA.
आपस्: आपस् n. (-पः) 1 Water. 2 Sin. E. आप to obtain, असुन् aff.
आपस्कार: आपस्कार n. (-रं) The root or extremity of the trunk or body. E. अपस्कर filth, अण् aff.
आपस्तम्व: आपस्तम्व m. (-म्वः) The name of a sage and legislator.
आपाक: आपाक m. (-कः) 1 A potter's kiln. 2 A baking oven. E. आङ्, पच् to bake, घञ् aff.
आपाण्डुर: आपाण्डुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Slightly pale, palish. E. आङ् dimin. पाण्डुर pale.
आपात: आपात m. (-तः) 1 Throwing down, causing to descend. 2 Falling, descending. 3 The instant, the current moment. E. आङ् पत to go, to fall, घञ् aff.
आपाततस्: आपाततस् ind. Immediately, instantly. E. तसि added to the last.
आपान: आपान m. (-तः) A tavern, a liquor shop, a place for drinking in society. E. आङ्, पा to drink, ल्युट् aff.
आपालि: आपालि m. (-लिः) A louse. E. आङ्, पल to go, इन् affix; the penultimate irregularly long.
आपी: आपी f. (-पी) The twentieth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion.
आपीड: आपीड m. (-डः) 1 Squeezing, compressing. 2 Giving pain, hurting. 3 A chaplet tied on the crown of the head. E. आङ् before पीड to pain, अच् aff.
आपीडन: आपीडन n. (-नं) 1 Squeezing, compressing, tying or drawing tightly. 2 Embracing, clasping. 3 Giving pain, hurting. E. आङ् before पीड to pain, affix ल्युट्.
आपीडित: आपीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Squeezed, compressed. 3 Bound tightly. 3 Embraced. 4 Hurt. E. आङ् before पीडित pressed.
आपीत: आपीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Drank up. 2 Very yellow. n. (-तं) A pyritic mineral. E. आङ् before पीत drank or yellow.
आपीन: आपीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Stout, fat. m. (-नः) A well. n. (-नं) An udder. E. आङ् and पीन fat, large.
आपूपिक: आपूपिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 A baker. 2 A confectioner. 3 One who eats cakes, one for whom they are good, &c. n. (-कं) A multitude of cakes. E. अपप a cake, ठक् or ठञ् aff.
आपूप्य: आपूप्य m. (-प्यः) Flour, meal. E. अपूप a cake, यञ् aff.
आपूर्ति: आपूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Filling. 2 Satisfaction, fulness. E. आङ् before पूर्त्ति fulness.
आपूर्त्ति: आपूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Filling. 2 Satisfaction, fulness. E. आङ् before पूर्त्ति fulness.
आपृच्छा: आपृच्छा f. (-च्छा) Conversation, speaking to or with. E. आङ्, प्रच्छ to ask, अङ् and टाप् affs.
आप्त: आप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Trusted, confidential. 2 Gained, obtained. 3 True. 4 Apt, fit. 5 A friend. 6 Appointed. 7 Authentic. 8 Accused, prosecuted. f. (-प्ता) A twisted band or lock of hair. n. (-प्तं) 1 Quotient. 2 Equation of a degree. E. आप to obtain, क्त aff.
आप्तकारिन्: आप्तकारिन् m. (-री) A trusty agent, a confidential servant. E. आप्त trusted, and कारिन् who acts.
आप्तगर्व: आप्तगर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Proud, arrogant. E. आप्त and गर्ब्ब pride.
आप्तगर्व्व: आप्तगर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Proud, arrogant. E. आप्त and गर्ब्ब pride.
आप्तगर्भा: आप्तगर्भा f. (-र्भा) A pregnant woman. E. आप्त and गर्भ embryo.
आप्तवचन: आप्तवचन n. (-नं) A received text, an authority. E. आप्त and वचन text.
आप्ति: आप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Gain, acquisition. 2 Binding, joining. 3 Connexion, relation. 4 Fitness, aptitude. E. आप to obtain, क्तिन् aff.
आप्तोक्ति: आप्तोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 An augment or affix, (in grammar.) 2 A word of received acceptation, and established by usage only. E. आप्त received, उक्ति speech.
आप्य: आप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) 1 Watery, consisting of water, as froth, &c. 2 Obtainable, to be obtained. n. (-प्यं) A plant, a kind of costus. E. अप water, यञ् affix; or आप to get, यत् aff.
आप्यान: आप्यान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Stout, robust. 2 Fat. E. आङ् before स्फाय to grow, क्त aff.
आप्यायन: आप्यायन n. (-नं) 1 Pleasing, satisfying. 2 Satiety, satisfaction. 3 Advancing. 4 Corpulency, growing or being fat or stout. E. आङ् before स्फाय to increase, ल्युट् aff.
आप्यायित: आप्यायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pleased. 2 Satisfied. 3 Increased, improved. 4 Stout, fat. E. आङ् before स्फाय to increase, क्त aff.
आप्रच्छन: आप्रच्छन n. (-नं) Civility upon receiving or parting with a visitor, welcome, adieu, &c. E. आङ्, प्रच्छ to ask, ल्युट् aff.
आप्रपद: आप्रपद n. (-दं) A dress reaching to the feet. E. आङ् and प्र before पद a foot.
आप्रपदीन: आप्रपदीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) A dress reaching from the shoulders to the feet. E. आङ् and प्र prefixed to पद a foot, ख aff.
आप्रपदीनक: आप्रपदीनक n. (-कं) See the preceding. E. कन् added.
आप्लव: आप्लव m. (-वः) 1 Bathing. 2 Sprinkling with water. E. आङ्, प्लु to swim, अप् aff.
आप्लवन: आप्लवन n. (-नं) 1 Sprinkling with water. 2 Bathing. आङ् before प्लु to swim, affix ल्युट्.
आप्लवव्रतिन्: आप्लवव्रतिन् m. (-ती) An initiated householder, one who has passed through the first order, that of the Brahmacārī, and is admitted into the second. E. आङ् before प्लव bathing, व्रतिन् performer of a व्रत, or religious obligation; bathing being part of the prescribed ceremony.
आप्लाव: आप्लाव m. (-वः) 1 Bathing. 2 Sprinkling, wetting. 3 A submerging. 4 A flood, an inundation. E. आङ्, प्लुङ् to swim, घञ् aff.
