आर्यवेश: आर्य्यवेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Well clothed, fine. E. आर्य्य and वेश vesture.
आर्य्यवेश: आर्य्यवेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Well clothed, fine. E. आर्य्य and वेश vesture.
आर्यागीति: आर्य्यागीति f. (-तिः) A variety of the Āryā metre, containing eight equal feet or thirty-two syllabic instants in each verse of the couplet. E. आर्य्यां and गीति another metre.
आर्य्यागीति: आर्य्यागीति f. (-तिः) A variety of the Āryā metre, containing eight equal feet or thirty-two syllabic instants in each verse of the couplet. E. आर्य्यां and गीति another metre.
आर्यावर्त: आर्य्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The holy land, the country extending from the eastern to the western sea, and bounded on the north and south, by the Himāla and Vindhya mountains. E. आय्य venerable, आवर्त्त abode.
आर्य्यावर्त्त: आर्य्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The holy land, the country extending from the eastern to the western sea, and bounded on the north and south, by the Himāla and Vindhya mountains. E. आय्य venerable, आवर्त्त abode.
आर्वाक्: आर्व्वाक् ind. 1 After, afterwards. 2 Behind. E. अर्व्वाक् and अण् pleonastic aff.
आर्व्वाक्: आर्व्वाक् ind. 1 After, afterwards. 2 Behind. E. अर्व्वाक् and अण् pleonastic aff.
आर्ष: आर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षी-र्षं) Relating or belonging to or derived from a Ṛṣi. m. (-र्षः) A form of marriage, the father of the bride receiving one or two pair of kine from the bridegroom. n. (-र्षं) The Vedas. f. (-र्षा) One of the orders of the metres of the Vedas. E. ऋषि and अण् aff.
आर्षभि: आर्षभि m. (-भिः) A name of BHARATA, emperor of India. E. ऋषभ excellent, and इञ् aff.
आर्षभ्य: आर्षभ्य m. (-भ्यः) A steer fit to be let loose. E. ऋषभ an ox, ञ्य aff.
आर्षेय: आर्षेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Relating or belonging to or derived from a Ṛṣi. 2 Venerable, respectable. E. ऋषि a sage, ढक् affix; also आर्ष and आर्ष्य.
आर्षोढा: आर्षोढा f. (-ढा) A wife married according to the Ārṣa form. E. आर्ष and ऊढ married.
आर्हत: आर्हत m. (-तः) A Jaina, a follower of the doctrines of a Jina or Arhat. E. अर्हत् a Jina, अण् aff.
आर्हत्य: आर्हत्य n. (-त्यं-न्ती) The quality or practice of an Arhat or Jain saint. E. अर्हत् ष्यञ् affix fem. ङीष् with the nasal inserted.
आल: आल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Large, extensive. n. (-लं) Yellow orpiment. E. अल to adorn, in the causal form, अच् aff.
आलगर्द: आलगर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) A species of Cobra. E. see अलगर्द्द.
आलगर्द्द: आलगर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) A species of Cobra. E. see अलगर्द्द.
आलभ्य: आलभ्य ind. Having received or obtained. E. आङ् before लभि to gain, ल्यप् aff.
आलम्भ: आलम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Slaughter, killing. 2 Embracing. E. आङ्, लभि to kill, affix धञ्.
आलम्भ्य: आलम्भ्य mfn. (म्भ्यः-म्भ्या-म्भ्यं) 1 Fit or proper to be killed. 2 Obtainable, to be obtained. E. आङ् before लभि with ण्यत् aff.
आलम्ब: आलम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 A receptacle. a prop, an asylum or support. 2 Depending on or from. 3 A perpendicular. E. आङ् before लम्बि to go, affix घञ्.
आलम्बन: आलम्बन n. (-नं) 1 Depending on or resting upon, hanging from. 2 The natural and necessary connexion of feeling with the cause by which it is excited. 3 Supporting, sustaining. E. आङ् and लवि to go, ल्युट् aff.
आलम्बित: आलम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pendant, suspended, hanging from or on. 2 Supported, upheld. 3 Protected. E. आङ् before लवि to go, affix क्त.
आलम्बिन्: आलम्बिन् mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि) 1 Depending on or from, hanging from, &c. 2 Supporting, maintaining. E. आलम्ब support, and इनि aff.
आलय: आलय m. (-यः) A house, a dwelling, a receptacle, an asylum. E. आङ्, लीङ् to enfold, धञ् aff.
आलवण्य: आलवण्य n. (-ण्यं) 1 Ugliness. 2 Insipidity. E. अ neg. लवण handsome, affix यञ्.
आलवाल: आलवाल n. (-लं) A basin for water round the root of a tree. E. आङ् before लू to cut or dig, and आलच् aff.
आलस: आलस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Idle, slothful, lazy. E. अलस idle, अण् affix: see अलस.
आलस्य: आलस्य mfn. (-स्यः-सी-स्यं) Idle, slothful, apathetic. n. (-स्यं) Idleness, sloth. E. अलस idle, and यञ् aff.
आलात: आलात n. (-तं) A firebrand, a coal burning or extinguished. E. अलात and अण् aff.
आलान: आलान n. (-नं) 1 The post to which an elephant is tied. 2 The rope that ties him. 3 A fetter, a tie. 4 Tying, binding. 5 A rope or string. E. आङ् before ला to take, आला to tie or fasten, affix ल्युट्.
आलाप: आलाप m. (-पः) 1 Speaking to, addressing, conversation. 2 Enumeration of the questions in an arithmetical or algebraic sum. E. आङ्, लप to speak, affix घञ्.
आलापन: आलापन n. (-नं) Speaking to, conversing with. E. आङ् before लप to speak, ल्युट् aff.
आलापनीय: आलापनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be said or spoken. 2 To be spoken to or addressed. E. आङ् before लप to speak, अनीयर् affix; also आलाप्य.
आलापिन्: आलापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Who speaks or converses. E. आङ् before लप to speak, णिनि aff.
आलाबु: आलाबु f. (-बुः) A pumpkin gourd: also आलाबू, अलाबु and अलाबू, q. v.
आलावर्त: आलावर्त्त n. (-र्त्तं) A fan made of cloth. E. आल orpiment, and आवर्त्त abode: stained or painted with some such substance.
आलावर्त्त: आलावर्त्त n. (-र्त्तं) A fan made of cloth. E. आल orpiment, and आवर्त्त abode: stained or painted with some such substance.
आलास्य: आलास्य m. (-स्यः) A crocodile. E. आल wide, large, and आस्य a mouth.
आलि: आलि mfn. sub. (-लिः-लिः) or ली-लि 1 Pure, honest, sincere. 2 Useless, idle, unmeaning. f. (-लिः-ली) 1 A woman's female friend. 2 A row or range, a continuous line. 3 A ridge or mound of earth, crossing ditches, dividing fields, &c. 4 A line, a race or family. m. (-लिः) 1 A scorpion. 2 A bee: see अलि. E. अल to adorn, to be able, &c. affix इण and the pen. made long; also आली, affix ङीप्.
आलिङ्गन: आलिङ्गन n. (-नं) Embracing, an embrace. E. आङ् before लिगि to approach, ल्युट् aff.
आलिङ्गित: आलिङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Embraced. E. आङ् before लिगि to approach, क्त aff.
आलिङ्गिन्: आलिङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) Embracing. m. (-ङ्गी) A small drum shaped like a barley corn, and carried upon the breast. E. आलिङ्ग an embrace, and इनि affix; also आलिङ्गी fem. ङीप् aff.
आलिङ्ग्य: आलिङ्ग्य mfn. (-ङ्ग्यः-ङ्ग्या-ङ्ग्यं) To be embraced. m. (-ङ्ग्यः) A small drum: see the preceding. E. आलिङ्ग and ण्यत् aff.
आलिञ्जर: आलिञ्जर m. (-रः) A large clay water jar. E. अलिञ्जर a jar. अण् aff.
आलिन्: आलिन् m. (-ली) A scorpion. E. see. आलि, affix इनि.
आलिन्द: आलिन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 A terrace before a house. 2 A raised place or terrace for sleeping upon. E. अलिन्द the same, and अण् affix: see अलिन्द, also आलिन्दक.
आलिप्त: आलिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Smeared, plastered, anointed. E. आङ् before लिप to smear, क्त aff.
आलिम्पन: आलिम्पन m. (-नः) Whitening or painting the floor, wall, &c. on festival occasions. आङ्, लिपि to plaster, and ल्युट् aff.
आली: आली f. (-ली) 1 A female friend. 2 A row or range. 3 A field, boundary or mound: see आलि.
आलीढ: आलीढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Eaten. 2 Licked. n. (-ढं) An attitude in shooting, the right knee advanced, the left leg retracted. E. आङ्, लिह to lick, क्त aff.
आलीढक: आलीढक n. (-कं) The frolicking of a calf. Sometimes written आढीलक.
आलीन: आलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Melted, fused. E. आङ् before ली to melt, क्त aff.
आलीनक: आलीनक n. (-कं) Tin. E. आलीन and affix वुन्.
आलु: आलु f. (-लुः) A pitcher, a small water jar. mn. (-लुः-लु) 1 An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum:) in the modern dialects this name is applied to the yam, potatoe, &c. 2 A raft, a float. m. (-लुः) An owl. E. ऋ to go, and उण् affix, आरु what goes, (in the earth, water, &c.) the initial is lengthened, and र is changed to ल.
आलुक: आलुक m. (-कः) 1 A name of the chief of the Nāgas or serpent race: see शेष. 2 An esculent root: see आलु. E. कन् added to the preceding.
आलून: आलून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Cut, cut off. E. आङ् before लून cut.
आलेखन: आलेखन n. (-नं) 1 Writing. 2 Painting. f. (-नी) A brush, a pencil. E. आङ् before लिख to write, affix ल्युट्.
आलेख्य: आलेख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) 1 To be written. 2 To be delineated or painted. n. (-ख्यं) 1 A painting. 2 A writing. E. आङ् before लिख to write, ण्यत् aff.
आलेख्यशेष: आलेख्यशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Dead, deceased. E. आलेख्य painting. writing, and शेष final.
आलेप: आलेप m. (-पः) 1 Smearing, plastering, anointing. 2 Liniment. E. आङ् before लिपि to anoint, घञ् aff.
आलेपन: आलेपन n. (-नं) 1 Smearing, plastering. 2 Liniment. E. आङ्, before लिप to smear, ल्युट् aff.
आलोक: आलोक m. (-कः) 1 Sight, seeing, looking. 2 Light. 3 Flattery, complimentary language, panegyric. E. आङ् before लोकृ to see, घञ् aff.
आलोकन: आलोकन n. (-नं) Sight, seeing, looking. E. आङ्, लोकृ to see, ल्युट् aff.
आलोकित: आलोकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld. E. आङ् before लोक to see, क्त aff.
आलोचक: आलोचक n. (-कं) The faculty of vision or the cause of sight. E. आङ् before लोच and वुञ् aff.
आलोचन: आलोचन nf. (-नं-ना) Sight, seeing. E. आङ् before लोच to see, ल्युट् aff.
आलोचित: आलोचित mf. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seen, beheld. 2 Considered. E. आङ् before लोच to see, क्त affix.
आलोच्य: आलोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) To be seen thought of or considered; also आलोचनीय. E. आङ्, लोच to see, यत् aff.
आलोडन: आलोडन n. (-नं) 1 Mixing, blending. 2 Strirring, shaking, agitating. E. आङ् and लुड to stir, affix ल्युट्.
आलोडित: आलोडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Mixed, blended. 2 Shaken, agitated. E. आङ् before लुड to stir, affix क्त.
आलोल: आलोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Shaken, agitated. m. (-लः) Trembling, agitation. E. आङ् before लुड to shake, affix घञ, ड changed to ल.
आलोलित: आलोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, agitated. E. आङ् before लुल to shake, affix क्त.
आवनेय: आवनेय m. (-यः) The planet MARS. E. अवनी the earth, ढक् patronymic aff.
आवन्त्य: आवन्त्य m. (-न्त्यः) 1 The offspring of a degraded Brahman. 2 An inhabitant, &c. of Avanti or Ougein. E. अवन्ती and ण्यत् aff.
आवपन: आवपन n. (-नं) 1 Any vessel. 2 Weaving. 3 Sowing seed. E. आङ् वप to sow, ल्युट् aff.
आवरक: आवरक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A cover, a veil, what covers or conceals. E. आङ् before वृ with वुन् aff.
आवरण: आवरण n. (-णं) 1 Covering. 2 A covering, a garment. 3 A shield. 4 An outer bar or a fence, a wall. 5 An obstruction. 6 Mental blindness. E. आङ्, वृ to skreen, ल्युट् aff.
आवरणशक्ति: आवरणशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) The power of illusion, that which veils the real nature of things. E. आवरण and शक्ति power.
आवर्त: आवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Revolving, turning round. 2 A whirlpool. 3 A lock of hair that curls backwards, especially on a horse. 4 Deliberation, revolving. 5 A mineral substance, pyrites, marcasite. E. आङ्, वृत to choose, घञ् aff.
आवर्त्त: आवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Revolving, turning round. 2 A whirlpool. 3 A lock of hair that curls backwards, especially on a horse. 4 Deliberation, revolving. 5 A mineral substance, pyrites, marcasite. E. आङ्, वृत to choose, घञ् aff.
आवर्त्तका: आवर्त्तका f. (-का) 1 A revolution, a whirl. 2 A whirlpool. 3 A curl of hair, especially on a horse. 4 Revolution of the mind from the influence of the senses. 5 The depression above the frontal ridge or over the eyebrows. f. (-की) The name of a creeping plant. E. कन added to the last.
आवर्तन: आवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Turning, turning round. 2 Churning. 3 Stirring any thing in fusion. 4 Melting metals together, alligation. 5 The time when shadows are cast in an opposite direction. 6 Repeating, doing over again. 7 Study, practising. f. (-नी) A crucible. E. आवर्त्त, ल्युट् affix; and ङीप् for the fem.
आवर्त्तन: आवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Turning, turning round. 2 Churning. 3 Stirring any thing in fusion. 4 Melting metals together, alligation. 5 The time when shadows are cast in an opposite direction. 6 Repeating, doing over again. 7 Study, practising. f. (-नी) A crucible. E. आवर्त्त, ल्युट् affix; and ङीप् for the fem.
आवर्तनमणि: आवर्त्तनमणि m. (-णिः) A gem of a secondary order, commonly Rājāvartta. E. आवर्त्तन the same, and मणि a jewel.
आवर्त्तनमणि: आवर्त्तनमणि m. (-णिः) A gem of a secondary order, commonly Rājāvartta. E. आवर्त्तन the same, and मणि a jewel.
आवर्तनीय: आवर्त्तनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be whirled or turned round. 2 To be reversed. 3 To be repeated. E. आङ् before वृत to be, अनीयर् aff.
आवर्त्तनीय: आवर्त्तनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be whirled or turned round. 2 To be reversed. 3 To be repeated. E. आङ् before वृत to be, अनीयर् aff.
आवर्तमान: आवर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Advancing, proceeding. 2 Revolving, going round. E. आङ् before वृत to be, शानच् aff.
आवर्त्तमान: आवर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Advancing, proceeding. 2 Revolving, going round. E. आङ् before वृत to be, शानच् aff.
आवर्तिन्: आवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) What whirls or turns upon itself. m. (-र्त्ती) A horse having curls of hair on various parts of his body: it is considered as a lucky mark. f. (-नी) A whirlpool. E. आबर्त्त and इनि aff.
आवर्त्तिन्: आवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) What whirls or turns upon itself. m. (-र्त्ती) A horse having curls of hair on various parts of his body: it is considered as a lucky mark. f. (-नी) A whirlpool. E. आबर्त्त and इनि aff.
आवर्हित: आवर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eradicated, plucked up by the roots. E. आङ्, वर्ह to hurt, affix क्त.
आवलि: आवलि f. (-लिः) 1 A row, a range, a continuous line. 2 A series, dynasty, a lineage. E. आङ्, वल to move, इन् affix; also आवली, taking ङीप्.
आवल्य: आवल्य n. (-ल्यं) Weakness. E. अवल weak, यञ् aff.
आवश्य: आवश्य n. (-श्यं) Necessity, inevitable act or conclusion. E. अवश्य and अण.
आवश्यक: आवश्यक n. (-कं) Necessity, inevitable act or conclusion. E. अवश्य certain, affixes अण् and कन्.
आवश्यकत्व: आवश्यकत्व n. (-त्वं) Necessity, inevitability. E. त्व added to आवश्य, also with तल्, आवश्यकता.
आवसथ: आवसथ mn. (-थः-थं) 1 A house. 2 A fire temple or place where sacrificial fire is preserved. m. (-थः) 1 A treatise on the poetical metre called Ārya. (आर्य्याकोषः) see आर्य्या. 2 A particular religious observance. E. आङ् before वस to dwell, अथ Uṇādi aff.
आवसथिक: आवसथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Inhabiting a house, household, domestic. E. आवसथ and ष्ठल् aff.
आवसथ्य: आवसथ्य n. (-थ्यं) A house. E. आवसथ and ञ्य added.
आवसित: आवसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stored, (as grain.) 2 Winnowed. 3 Ripe, full grown. E. आङ् and अब reverse, and षो to destroy, participial affix क्त; also अवसित.
आवह: आवह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) What bears or conveys. m. (-हः) One of the seven winds. E. आङ् before वह to bear, अच् aff.
आवहत्: आवहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) Obtaining, receiving. E. आङ् before वह to hear, affix शतृ.
आवहमान: आवहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Followed, succeeded, come in succession. E. आङ् before वह to hear, शानच् aff.
आवहित: आवहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rooted up, extirpated. E. आङ् before वह to bear, क्त aff.
आवात्: आवात् mfn. (-वान्-वान्ती-वात्) Blowing. E. आङ् before वा to blow, affix शतृ.
आवाधा: आवाधा f. (-धा) 1 Pain. 2 Distress. 3 Segment of the base of a triangle. E. आङ् before वाधा the same.
आवाप: आवाप m. (-पः) 1 A basin for water round the root of tree. 2 A bracelet. 3 Hostile purpose, intention of going to war, (as a king.) 4 Throwing, casting, directing. 5 Sowing seed. 6 Throwing additional ingredients into any compound, (in pharmacy, &c.) in course of preparation. 7 Mixing, inserting. 8 Uneven ground. 9 A vessel. 10 Principal sacrifice with fire. E. आङ्, वप to sow, घञ् aff.
आवापक: आवापक m. (-कः) A bracelet of gold, &c. E. कन् added the last.
आवापन: आवापन n. (-नं) 1 A loom, an implement for weaving. 2 A reel or frame for winding thread. E. आङ्, वप to weave, ल्युट् aff.
आवारि: आवारि m. (-रिः) A shop, a stall. E. आङ् before वृ to nourish, in the causal form, इ aff.
आवार्य: आवार्य्य ind. Covering, hiding, concealing. E. आङ् before वृ to screen, ल्यप् aff.
आवार्य्य: आवार्य्य ind. Covering, hiding, concealing. E. आङ् before वृ to screen, ल्यप् aff.
आवाल: आवाल n. (-लं) A basin for water round the foot of a tree. E. आङ् before वल to move, घञ् affix; also आलवाल.
आवाल्य: आवाल्य n. (-ल्यं) Age or time ending with infancy. E. आङ् unto, बाल्य childhood.
आवास: आवास m. (-सः) A house, a dwelling. E. आङ्, वस to dwell, affix घञ्.
आवाहन: आवाहन n. (-नं) 1 Calling. 2 Inviting. 3 Offering oblations with fire. f. (-नी) A particular position of the hands or the palms put together, and the thumbs put at the root of the ring finger. E. आङ् before वक्त to bear, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
आवाहित: आवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Invoked, invited. E. आङ् before वह to bear, causal form, क्त aff.
आविक: आविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Woollen, &c. or any thing relating to or derived from a sheep. m. (-कः) A blanket, woollen cloth. E. अवि a sheep, वुञ् aff.
आविकसौत्रिक: आविकसौत्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made of woollen thread. E. आविक and सूत्र a thread, ठञ् aff.
आविग्न: आविग्न m. (-ग्नः) A small fruit tree, vulgarly Caronda, (Carissa carondas.) also अविग्न.
आविद्ध: आविद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Pierced, wounded. 2 Crooked. 3 Cast, thrown, sent. 4 Disappointed. 5 Stupid, foolish. E. आङ् before व्यध to hurt, क्त aff.
आविद्धकर्णी: आविद्धकर्णी f. (-र्णीं) A plant, (Aknidhi:) also आविद्धकर्णिका f. (-का.)
आविध: आविध m. (-धः) An awl, a drill, a kind of gimblet worked by a string. E. आङ्, व्यध to pierce, घञ् or क aff.
आविर्भाव: आविर्भाव m. (-वः) Manifestation, presence, becoming visible. E. आविस् manifestly, and भाव condition.
आविर्भूत: आविर्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Appeared, manifest, become visible. E. आविस् and भूत become.
आविल: आविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Foul, turbid. E. आङ्, विल to break, and क aff.
आविष्करण: आविष्करण n. (-णं) Manifestation, making visible. E. आविस् an करण making.
आविष्कार: आविष्कार m. (-रः) Becoming or making visible. E. आविस् and कार making.
आविष्कृत: आविष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made or become visible, evident, manifest. E. आविस् apparent, and कृत made.
आविष्ट: आविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Entered. 2 Possessed, (by a demon, &c.) 3 Possessed, engrossed, (by any sentiment or feeling.) E. आविश to enter, affix क्त.
आविस्: आविस् ind. Manifest, evident. E. आङ्, उङ् to sound, इर् aff.
आवीत: आवीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Passed, gone. 2 Placed, hung. m. (-तः) The sacrificial cord worn in any particular manner. E. आङ् before वीत gone.
आवीतिन्: आवीतिन् m. (-ती) A Brahman who wears the cord in any particular manner. E. इनि added to the last: see प्राचीनावीतिन्.
आवूक: आवूक m. (-कः) A father, (in theatrical language.) E. अव to preserve, ऊकन् affix, and the initial lengthened.
आवृत्: आवृत् f. (-वृत्) Order, method. E. आङ् before वृत to choose, affix क्विप्.
आवृत: आवृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Enclosed, surrounded, (by a ditch, wall, &c.) 2 Covered, screened. 3 Invested, inclosed, involved. 4 Spread, overspread, overcast. 5 Filled with, abounding with. m. (-तः) A man of mixed origin, the son of a Brahman, by a woman of the Ugra caste. E. आङ्, वृ to nourish, affix क्त.
आवृत्त: आवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Whirled, stirred, turned round. 2 Reverted, averted. 3 Retreated, fled. E. आङ् before वृत to be, क्त aff.
आवृत्ति: आवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Reversion, turning back or from. 2 Flight, retreat. 3 Revolving, going round. 4 Wordly existence, the revolution of births. 5 Use, employment, application. E. आङ् before वृत, क्तिन् aff.
आवेग: आवेग m. (-गः) 1 Hurry, haste. 2 Flurry, agitation. f. (-गी) A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.) E. आङ् before विज to be alarmed, घञ् and ङीप् aff.
आवेदक: आवेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One who makes known. m. (-कः) 1 An appellant, a suitor. 2 An informer. E. आङ् before विद to know, causal form, वुन् aff.
आवेदन: आवेदन n. (-नं) Representing, addressing or apprising respectfully. E. आङ् and वेदन informing.
आवेदित: आवेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made known, communicated, represented. E. आङ् before विद to know, causal form, क्त aff.
आवेद्य: आवेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be represented or made known. Ind. Having made known. E. आङ् before विद् to know, causal form, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
आवेद्यमान: आवेद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Stating, representing. E. आङ् before विद to know, causal form, शानच् aff.
आवेश: आवेश m. (-शः) 1 Entrance, entering. 2 Pride, arrogance. 3 Indistinctness of idea, apoplectic or epileptic giddiness. 4 Absorption of the faculties in one wish or idea, devotedness to an object. 5 Demoniac frenzy, possession, &c. E. आङ् before विश to enter, घञ् aff.
आवेशन: आवेशन n. (-नं) 1 Entrance, entering. 2 A house in which work is carried on, a workshop, a manufactory, &c. 3 Possession by devils, &c. 4 Passion, fury. 5 The disk of the sun. E. आङ्, विश to enter, ल्युट् aff.
आवेशिक: आवेशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 A guest, a visiter. 2 Entering into. 3 Own, peculiar, unparticipated. 4 Inherent. E. आङ्, विश to enter, ठक् aff.
आवेष्टक: आवेष्टक m. (-कः) A wall, a fence, an enclosure. E. आङ्, वेष्ट to surround, वुन् aff.
आवेष्टन: आवेष्टन n. (-नं) 1 Wrapping round, binding, tying. 2 A wrapper, an envelope, a bandage. 3 An inclosure. E. आङ् before वेष्ट to surround, ल्युट् aff.
आवेष्टित: आवेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Surrounded, enveloped, inclosed, bound or tied. E. आङ् before वेष्ट to inclose, क्त aff.
आशंसन: आशंसन n. (-नं) 1 Expecting, wishing. 2 Declaring, asserting. E. आङ् before शसि to wish, &c. ल्युट् aff.
आशंसा: आशंसा f. (-सा) 1 Wish, desire. 2 Speech, declaration. E. आङ्, शसि to desire, अङ् and टाप् aff.
आशंसित: आशंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, expected. 2 Declared, said. E. आङ् before शसि to desire, क्त aff.
आशंसितृ: आशंसितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Wishing, desiring. 2 Asserting. E. आङ्, शसि to wish, तृच् aff.
आशंसु: आशंसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Wishing, desiring. E. आङ्, शसि to wish, and उ aff.
आशक्त: आशक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Able, powerful. E. आङ् and शक्त able.
आशक्ति: आशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Power, ability, might. E. आङ् before शक्ति power.
आशङ्कनीय: आशङ्कनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be doubted, questionable. 2 To be apprehended. E. आङ् before शकि to doubt, अनीयर् aff.
आशङ्का: आशङ्का f. (-ङ्का) 1 Fear, apprehension. 2 Doubt, uncertainty. E. आङ्, शकि to doubt, अच् and टाप् affs.
आशङ्कान्वित: आशङ्कान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Afraid. 2 Doubting, uncertain. E. आशङ्का and अन्वित having.
आशङ्कित: आशङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Feared, dreaded. 2 Doubted. E. आङ् before शकि to doubt, क्त aff.
आशन: आशन m. (-नः) A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) see असन and आसन.
आशय: आशय m. (-यः) 1 Meaning, intention. 2 Free will or pleasure. 3 A asylum, an abode or retreat. 4 A receptacle, a recipient. 5 Any recipient or containing vessel or viscus of the body, as रक्ताशय the heart, आमाशय the stomach, &c. 6 The stomach in particular. 7 The mind. 8 Property, possessions. 9 A miser, a  niggard. 10 Virtue and vice. 11 Fate, fortune. 12 The Jack, a kind of bread-fruit tree. E. आङ्, शीङ् to rest, अच् aff.
आशयाश: आशयाश m. (-शः) A name of fire: see आश्रयास.
आशयितृ: आशयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Feeding, a feeder, one who gives food. 2 Protecting, a protector. 3 Recipient, a receiver. E. अश to eat, causal form, affix शतृ or आङ् before शीङ् to rest, with the same aff.
आशर: आशर n. (-रः) 1 Fire. 2 An imp, a goblin. E. आङ् before शृ to injure, अप् affix; also आशिर.
आशल: आशल m. (-लः) A tree: see जीवक.
आशव: आशव n. (-वं) A spirit distilled from molasses: see आसव.
आशा: आशा f. (-शा) 1 Hope, desire. 2 Length. 3 A quarter, a region. E. आङ् before अशू to expand, अच् and टाप् affs.
आशाढ: आशाढ m. (-ढः) 1 The month Āśāḍha, (June-July.) 2 A staff of Palāśa wood carried by ascetics. f. (-ढा) The name of two of the lunar mansions: see पूर्व्वाषाढा and उत्तराषाढा.
आशान्वित: आशान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having hope. E. आशा and अन्वित possessed of.
आशाप्राप्त: आशाप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Successful, possessing the object hoped for. E. आशा and प्राप्त obtained.
आशाबन्ध: आशाबन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Confidence, trust, expectation. 2 A spider's web. E. आशा hope, &c. and बन्ध a binding.
आशाभङ्ग: आशाभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Disappointment. E. आशा and भङ्ग breaking.
आशावत्: आशावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Hoping, having hope. E. आशा and मतुप् poss. aff.
आशाहीन: आशाहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Desponding, despairing. E. आशा and हीन destitute of.
आशिञ्जित: आशिञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tinkling, applied to the ornaments worn on the hands and feet. E. आङ् before शिजि to tinkle, क्त aff.
आशित: आशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. आङ् before अश to eat, affix क्त; also अशित.
आशितङ्गवीन: आशितङ्गवीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Formerly grazed by cattle. E. आशित eaten, गवीन irregular derivative of गो a cow, and खश् affix; also अशितङ्गवीन.
आशितम्भव: आशितम्भव n. (-वं) Food, victuals. m. (-वः) Satisfaction, satiety. E. आशित and भव produced by, from भू and खश् aff.
आशितृ: आशितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Voracious, gluttonous, eating excessively. E. अश to eat, and तृच् affix, इ inserted.
आशिर: आशिर m. (-रः) 1 Fire. 2 A goblin or imp. E. आङ् before अश to eat, किरच् Uṇādi aff.
आशिस्: आशिस् f. (-शीः) 1 Blessing, benediction, bestowing or wishing a blessing upon others. 2 A serpent's fang. E. आङ् before शास to rule, क्विप् affix, and आ is changed to इ.
आशी: आशी f. (-शीः) 1 Wishing or bestowing a blessing. 2 A serpent's fang. 3 A kind of venom, the venom of a snake. E. आङ् before अश to eat, अच् and ङीप् affixes: see the preceding.
आशीर्वचन: आशीर्वचन n. (-नं) A blessing, a benediction. E. आशिस् and वचन speech.
आशीर्वाद: आशीर्वाद m. (-दः) A blessing, a benediction. E. आशिस् and वाद
आशीविष: आशीविष m. (-षः) A snake. E. आशी a fang, and विष poison; in whose fang is venom.
आशु: आशु mfn. (-शुः-शुः-शु) Going quickly, fleet, fast. mn. (-शुः-शु) Rice ripening in the rainy season. n. adv. (-शु) Quick, quickly. E. अशू to pervade, उण् aff.
आशुकारिन्: आशुकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Doing any thing quickly, smart, active. 2 (In medicine) Operating speedily. E. आशु and कारिन् what acts.
आशुग: आशुग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going or moving quickly, swift, fleet. m. (-गः) 1 The wind. 2 An arrow. E. आशु quick, and ग who goes.
आशुपत्री: आशुपत्री f. (-त्री) A tree which yields frankincense, (Boswellia serrata). see शल्लकी.
आशुव्रीहि: आशुव्रीहि m. (-हिः) Rice ripening in the rainy season. E. आशु quick, and व्रीहि rice; that is, of rapid growth; also आशु. so आशुधान्य n. (-न्यं) and other compounds.
आशुशुक्षणि: आशुशुक्षणि m. (-णिः) 1 Fire. 2 Wind, air. E. आशु before शुष to dry in the reiterative form, and अनि Uṇādi aff.
आशौच: आशौच n. (-चं) Impurity. E. अशुचि impure, अञ् aff.
आश्चर्य: आश्चर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Astonishing, wonderful. m. (-र्य्यः) Surprise, astonishment. E. आङ् before चर to go, deriv. irregular.
आश्चर्य्य: आश्चर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Astonishing, wonderful. m. (-र्य्यः) Surprise, astonishment. E. आङ् before चर to go, deriv. irregular.
आश्चर्यत्व: आश्चर्य्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Wonderfulness. 2 Wonder, astonishment. E. आश्चर्य्य and त्व; or with ता, आश्चर्य्यता.
आश्चर्य्यत्व: आश्चर्य्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Wonderfulness. 2 Wonder, astonishment. E. आश्चर्य्य and त्व; or with ता, आश्चर्य्यता.
आश्चोतन: आश्चोतन n. (-नं) 1 Aspersion, sprinkling. 2 Applying ghee, &c. to the eyelids. E. आङ् before श्चुत to sprinkle, affix ल्युट्.
आश्म: आश्म mfn. (-श्मः-श्मा-श्मं) Stony, made of stone, &c. E. अश्मन् stone, and अण् affix: with the final rejected.
आश्मन: आश्मन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Made of stone, stony, stone. E. अश्मन् and अञ aff. m. (-नः) A name of ARUṆA, the charioteer of the sun. E. अश्मन् stone, अण् affix: immoveable as a stone, having no legs.
आश्मिक: आश्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made of stone, consisting of stone, &c. E. अश्मन् and ठक्.
आश्यान: आश्यान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dried partially, consolidated, coagulated. E. आङ् dimin. श्यान dry.
आश्रम: आश्रम m. (-मः) 1 A religious order, of which there are four kinds referable to the different periods of life, 1st, that of the student or Brahmacārī; 2d, that of the householder or Gṛhastha; 3d, that of the anchorite or Vānaprastha; and 4th, that of the beggar or Bhikṣu: see ब्रह्मचारी, &c. 2 A college, a school. 3 A hermitage, the abode of retired saints or sages. 4 A wood or thicket. E. आङ् before श्रम to perform religious austerities, affix घञ्.
आश्रमगुरु: आश्रमगुरु m. (-रुः) The head of a religious order, a preceptor, a principal. E. आश्रम a convent, and गुरु senior.
आश्रमधर्म: आश्रमधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The special duty or duties of each order of life. E. आश्रम and धर्म्म duty.
आश्रमधर्म्म: आश्रमधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The special duty or duties of each order of life. E. आश्रम and धर्म्म duty.
आश्रमिक: आश्रमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to one of the four orders, see आश्रम. E. आश्रम as above, and ठक् aff.
आश्रमिन्: आश्रमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिणी-मि) 1 Belonging to one of the four orders. 3 Belonging to a hermitage, a hermit, an anchorite, &c. E. आश्रम and इनि aff.
आश्रय: आश्रय m. (-यः) Being inclined or addicted to, following, practising. 2 A recipient, the person or thing in which any quality or article is inherent, retained or received. 3 An asylum, a  place of refuge. 4 A patron, a protector. 5 Having recourse to a protector or asylum. 6 A dwelling. 7 Contiguity, vicinity. 8 Source, origin. 9 A plea, an excuse. 10 Appropriate act, one consistent with the character of the agent. E. आङ् before श्री to serve, अच् aff.
आश्रयण: आश्रयण n. (-णं) Refuge, asylum, means of protection or security. आङ् before श्रि to serve, ल्युट् aff.
आश्रयणीय: आश्रयणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be had recourse to. 2 To be practised or followed. E. आङ् before श्रि to serve, affix अनीयर्.
आश्रयभूत: आश्रयभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Protecting, supporting, one who is the refuge of any other. E. आश्रय and भूत become.
आश्रयाश: आश्रयाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) A forfeiter of an asylum, one who by misconduct, &c. loses patronage or protection. m. (-शः) A name of fire. E. आश्रय a house, &c. अश to eat, or consume, and अण् affix: similar compounds occur frequently, as आश्रयध्वंसिन्, आश्रयभुज्, &c.
आश्रव: आश्रव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Compliant, obedient. m. (-वः) 1 A promise, an engagement. 2 Distress, fatigue. 3 Fault, transgression. E. आङ्, श्रु to hear, अच् aff.
आश्रि: आश्रि f. (-श्रिः) The edge of a sword: see अश्रि.
आश्रित: आश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Inhabiting, dwelling in, resorting to as a retreat or asylum. 2 Following, practising, observing. 3 Using, employing, having recourse to. 4 Receiving any thing, as an inherent or integral part. 5 Taking one's station at or on, as at a window or a seat, &c. 6 A dependant. E. आङ् before श्रि to serve, क्त aff.
आश्रित्य: आश्रित्य ind. 1 Having sought or obtained an asylum. 2 Having recourse to, employing, practising. E. आङ् before श्रि to serve, ल्यप् affix, तुक् augment.
आश्रुत: आश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised, agreed. 2 Heard. E. आङ् before श्रु to hear, क्त aff.
आश्लिष्ट: आश्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Embraced. 2 Embracing, who or what embraces. 3 Connected, interwoven, blended. 4 Attaching to, joining, who or what adheres to. 5 Invested, spread. 6 Connected as a consequence, deduced, concluded. E. आङ् before श्लिष to fold, क्त aff.
आश्लेष: आश्लेष m. (-षः) 1 Embracing, an embrace. 2 Site of any act. 3 Intimate connexion. E. आङ्, श्लिष to fold, घञ् aff.
आश्व: आश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वी-श्वं) Relating to a horse, drawn by horses, equestrian, &c. n. (-श्वं) 1 A number of horses. 2 A chariot drawn by horses. E. अश्व a horse, and अण् aff.
आश्वत्थ: आश्वत्थ m. (-त्थः) The fruit of the holy fig tree. E. अश्वत्थ and अण् aff.
आश्वत्थिक: आश्वत्थिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to or produced by the Aśvattha tree. 2 Flowering of the Aśvattha (the time when.) E. अश्वत्थ and ठक् aff.
आश्वयुज: आश्वयुज mfn. (-जः-जी-जं) Belonging to or occurring in the same month of Āśvina. m. (-जः) The month Āśvina. (September- October.) f. (-जी) The day of full moon in Āśvina. E. अश्वयुज the first lunar mansion, affix अण् and fem. ङीप्.
आश्वरथ: आश्वरथ mfn. (-थः-थी-थं) Belonging to a chariot. E. अश्वरथ and अञ् aff.
आश्वलक्षणिक: आश्वलक्षणिक m. (-कः) A farrier, a groom. E. अश्व, लक्षण a mark, ठक् aff.
आश्वलायन: आश्वलायन m. (-नं) The name of a sage and legislator, &c. E. अश्वलायन and अण् patronymic aff.
आश्वसत्: आश्वसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Breathing, alive. 2 Recovering, reviving. E. आङ् before श्वस to breathe, शतृ aff.
आश्वसित: आश्वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Encouraged, cheered, consoled. E. आङ् before श्वस to breathe, क्त aff.
आश्वास: आश्वास m. (-सः) 1 Completion, cessation. 2 A chapter or section, the division of a book. 3 A probable story. 4 Breathing. E. आङ्, श्वस to breathe, to live, घञ् aff.
आश्वासक: आश्वासक m. (-कः) Clothing. mfn. (-कः-सिका-कं) Consoling, comforting. E. आङ् before श्वस to breathe, causal form, वुन् aff.
आश्वासन: आश्वासन n. (-नं) Consoling, encouraging, reviving. E. आङ् before श्वस to breathe, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
आश्वासित: आश्वासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Encouraged, comforted. E. आङ् before श्वस to breathe, causal form, क्त aff.
आश्वास्य: आश्वास्य ind. Having recovered or revived. E. आङ् before श्वस to breathe, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
आश्विक: आश्विक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Equestrian, cavalier, relating to a horse, drawn by horses, &c. E. अश्व and ठञ् aff.
आश्विन: आश्विन m. (-नः) The month Āśvina, (September-October.) E. अश्विनी the constellation, अण् deriv. affix: when the moon is in Āśvinī.
आश्वीन: आश्वीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) A day's journey for a horse. E. अश्व a horse, and खञ् aff.
आश्विनेय: आश्विनेय m. du. (-यौ) The two twin sons of AŚVINĪ, by SŪRYA, and physicians of Svarga; one of them is named NĀSATYA, the other DASRA: or the patronymic may be used in the singular to designate either one of them. E. अश्विनी and ढक् aff.
आश्वीय: आश्वीय n. (-यं) A number of horses. E. अश्व a horse, and छ aff.
आषाढ: आषाढ m. (-ढः) 1 The name of a month, (June-July.) 2 A staff of the wood of the Palāśa, carried by an ascetic in the month Āṣāḍha. 3 The Malaya mountain. E. आषाढा the constellation, and अण् affix. f. (-ढी) The day of full moon in the month Āṣāḍha. f. (-ढा) The twenty-first and twenty-second lunar mansion; it is most commonly compounded with पूर्व्व and उत्तरः see पूर्व्वाषाढा and उत्तराषाढा. E. अ neg. सह to bear, अण् and टाप् aff.
आषाढक: आषाढक m. (-कः) The month Āṣāḍha: see the preceding, also अषाढक.
आषाढभव: आषाढभव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in the month Āṣāḍha. m. (-वः) The planet MARS. E. आषाढ the month, and भव produced, from भू and अच् aff.
आषाढाभू: आषाढाभू m. (-भूः) See the preceding. E. आषाढा the sign, and भू produced, from भू to be, affix क्विप्.
आष्ट्र: आष्ट्र n. (-ष्ट्रं) Æther, the sky or atmosphere. E. अस to throw, to send, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
आस: आस r. 2d cl. (आस्ते or आसते) 1 To sit. 2 To be present. 3 To be or exist. With अधि prefixed. 1 To inhabit, to dwell in. 2 To sit over or upon. 3 To mistake or err by taking one thing for another from similarity of appearance. With अभि, to sit or apply to, to study, to learn. With उत्, 1 To leave, to abandon. 2 To shake, agitate, &c. (as wind.) With उप, to worship, to do homage. With निर्, to expel. With प्र and निर्, to reject, to refute, to invalidate.
आस m. (-सः) A bow. E. अस to send or throw, affix घञ्.
आस्: आस् ind. (आः) An interjection, ah! oh! &c. implying. 1 Recollection. 2 Anger. 3 Menace. 4 Pain. 5 Affliction.
आसक्त: आसक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Zealously following or pursuing, intent or attached strongly to. 2 Trusting to, confiding in. 3 Eternal. adv. n. (-क्तं) Eternally. E. आङ्, षञ्ज to embrace, to move, participial affix क्त.
आसक्तचित्त: आसक्तचित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Of a fixed mind, intent on, devoted to, absorbed in. E. आसक्त and चित्त mind.
आसक्तचेतस्: आसक्तचेतस् mfn. (-ता-ताः-तः) Having the mind fixed or intent on any object. E. आसक्त and चेतस् the understanding.
आसक्तमनस्: आसक्तमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Having the mind fixed upon any object. E. आसक्त and मनस् the mind.
आसक्ति: आसक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Attachment to one object or pursuit, diligence, application. E. आङ् before षञ्ज to embrace, क्तिन् aff.
आसङ्ग: आसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Attachment to any object. 2 Association, connexion. 3 Proximity, contact. adv. n. (-ङ्गं) Eternally. adj. mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Eternal. E. आङ् always, षञ्ज to move, अच् aff.
आसङ्गत्य: आसङ्गत्य n. (-त्यं) Detachment, disunion. E. अ neg. सङ्गति union, ष्यञ् aff.
आसङ्गिनी: आसङ्गिनी f. (-नी) A whirlwind. E. आसङ्ग eternal, इनि and ङीप् affs.
आसज्जन: आसज्जन n. (-नं) Putting on dress, armour, ornaments, &c. E. आङ् before षज्ज to dress, ल्यट् aff.
आसज्ज्य: आसज्ज्य ind. Having put on. E. आङ् before षज्ज to dress, affix ल्यप्.
आसत्ति: आसत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Intimate union, meeting, junction. 2 Gain, profit, acquirement. 3 In logic, connexion or relation between two or more proximate terms and the sense they convey. E. आङ्, षद to go, affix क्तिन्.
आसन: आसन n. (-नं) 1 A stool, a seat. 2 Maintaining a post against an enemy. 3 The withers of an elephant, the part where the driver sits. 4 Halting, stopping. 5 Sitting in some peculiar posture, as in the custom of devotees, &c. eighty-four kinds are enumerated: see पद्मासन, &c. m. (-नः) A tree, (Pentapheca tomentosa.) also असन f. (-ना-नी) Stay, abiding, sitting. (-नी) 1 A shop, a stall. 2 A small seat, a stool. E. आस to abide, and युच् or ल्युट् aff.
आसन्द: आसन्द m. (-न्दः) A name of VIṢṆU. mfn. (-न्दः-न्दी) A small couch or oblong chair, having the seat made of basket work. E. आस sitting, and द what gives.
आसन्न: आसन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Near, proximate. m. (-न्नः) A setting sun. E. आङ्, षद to go, and क्त aff.
आसन्नकाल: आसन्नकाल m. (-लः) Hour of death. E. आसन्न and काल time.
आसव: आसव n. (-वं) 1 Rum, spirit distilled from sugar or molasses. 2 Spirituous liquor in general. E. आङ्, षूञ् to be generated, and अप् aff.
आसवद्रु: आसवद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The palmyra tree. E. आसव spirit, and द्रु a tree; the juice of the palmyra upon fermenting affording a spirituous liquor.
आसादन: आसादन n. (-नं) 1 Obtaining, attaining. 2 Accomplishing. 3 Going to or toward. E. आङ् before षद to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
आसादित: आसादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Obtained. 2 Reached, gone to. 3 Spread, extended, overspread. 4 Effected, completed. E. आङ् before षद to go, in the causal form, affix क्त.
आसाद्य: आसाद्य ind. 1 Having attained or reached. 2 Having obtained. E. आङ् before षद to go, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
आसाधन: आसाधन n. (-नं) Accomplishment, attainment. E. आङ् before षाध to succeed, ल्युट् aff.
आसार: आसार m. (-रः) 1 A hard shower. 2 Surrounding an enemy. 3 The army of an ally, or of a king whose dominions are separated by other intervening states. E. आङ्, सृ to go, घञ् aff.
आसाव्य: आसाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be born. E. षु to bear, affix ण्यत्.
आसिक: आसिक m. (-कः) A swordsman. E. असि a sword, and ठक् aff.
आसिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One who sits. E. आस to sit, ण्वुल् aff.
आसिक्त: आसिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Sprinkled. E. आङ् before विच to sprinkle, क्त aff.
आसित: आसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sat down. 2 Who sits or is seated. n. (-तं) 1 Place of abode, a city. 2 A seat. E. आस to sit, क्त aff.
आसिद्ध: आसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Accomplished, effected. 2 Put under restraint: see आसेध. E. आङ् before षिध to go, &c. affix क्त.
आसीन: आसीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sitting, seated. E. आस to sit, शानच् affix, form irr.
आसीनप्रचलायित: आसीनप्रचलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Nodding, rocking as seated, falling asleep. E. आसीन and प्रचलायित set in motion.
आसुति: आसुति m. (-तिः) Distilling, distillation. E. आङ्, षूञ् to produce, affix क्तिन्.
आसुतीबल: आसुतीबल m. (-लः) 1 A sacrificer at the full and change of the moon. 2 A distiller. E. आसुति and बलच् aff.
आसुर: आसुर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Infernal, demoniac, belonging or relating to the Asuras. m. (-रः) 1 An Asura or demon. 2 A form of marriage, in which the bridegroom gives to the bride, her father and paternal kinsmen, as much as he can afford. n. (-रं) Black salt. f. (-री) 1 A division of medicine, surgery, curing by cutting with instruments, applying the actual cautery, &c. 2 Mustard. E. असुर a demon, अण् and in the fem. ङीप्.
आसेक: आसेक m. (-कः) Sprinkling. E. आङ् before षिच to sprinkle, affix घञ्.
आसेचन: आसेचन n. (-नं) Sprinkling. mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Beloved, desired. E. आङ्, षिच to sprinkle, ल्युट् affix; also आसेचनक.
आसेचनक: आसेचनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) See the preceding. E. आङ्, षिच to sprinkle, ल्युट् and कन् aff. also असेचनक.
आसेद्धृ: आसेद्धृ m. (-द्धा) One who confines or arrests another. E. आङ् before षिध to go, and तृच् aff.
आसेध: आसेध m. (-धः) Arrest, legal restraint of four kinds; कालामेधः limit of time, स्थानामेधः confinement to a place, प्रवासासेधः prohibition against removal or departure, कर्म्मासेधः restriction from employment. E. आङ् before षिध to go, घञ् aff.
आसेध्य: आसेध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) To be interrupted, prohibited or restrained. E. आङ् before षिध to go, यत् aff.
आस्कन्दन: आस्कन्दन m. (-नं) 1 Going, going to, approaching. 2 Effacing, destroying. 3 Reproach, abuse. 4 War, battle. 5 Drying. E. आङ् before स्कन्द to go, ल्युट् aff.
आस्कन्दित: आस्कन्दित n. (-तं) The walk of a horse. E. आङ, स्कन्द to go, क्त aff.
आस्तर: आस्तर m. (-रः) 1 A covering, a coverlet, a blanket thrown over the back of a horse or elephant. 2 Spreading clothes, &c. 3 A carpet, a bed. E. आङ्, स्तृञ् to spread, and अप् aff.
आस्तरण: आस्तरण n. (-णं) 1 A carpet, a rug, a quilt, bed clothes. 2 A bed. 3 A layer of sacred grass spread out at a sacrifice. 4 An elephant's housings, a painted cloth or blanket worn on his back. E. as the preceding, affix ल्युट्.
आस्तिक: आस्तिक m. (-कः) The name of a Muni or saint. E. अस्ति who is, and वुञ् affix; from an expression of his father, (he is in the womb,) pronouncing his conception to have taken place before there were any external indications of it. mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A believer, pious, faithful. E. अस्ति as before, saying that there is a GOD, &c. in opposition to the नास्तिक an atheist, and ठक् aff.
आस्तिकता: आस्तिकता and f. (-ता) Belief in GOD. E. आस्तिक and तल् affix; also with त्व affix आस्तिकत्वं.
आस्तिकार्थद: आस्तिकार्थद m. (-दः) A name of a king, also called JANAMEJAYA. E. आस्तिक the Muni, अर्थ a request, and द who gives or grants; having at his request spared the Nāga, TAKṢAKA, from the destruction to which he had devoted the race.
आस्तीक: आस्तीक m. (-कः) The name of a Muni or saint, the son of JARATKĀRU, also a Muni: see आस्तिक. E. अस्ति and ठक् aff.
आस्तीकजननी: आस्तीकजननी f. (-नी) The wife of JARATKĀRU, a saint. E. आस्तीक as above, and जननी a mother, the mother of that saint.
आस्तीक्य: आस्तीक्य n. (-क्यं) Belief in Providence and a future world. E. आस्तिक a believer, and यञ् aff.
आस्तीर्ण: आस्तीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Spread, strewed, scattered. E. आङ् before स्तॄ to spread, क्त aff.
आस्तृत: आस्तृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Spread. 2 Covered. E. आङ् before स्तृ to spread, affix क्त.
आस्था: आस्था f. (-स्था) 1 Prop, stay, place or means of abiding. 2 An assembly. 3 Effort, pains, care. 4 Consideration, regard. E. आङ् before स्था to stay, to stand, आङ् and टाप् affs.
आस्थान: आस्थान nf. (-नं-नी) An assembly. n. (-नं) 1 Place, site. 2 Staying, abiding. 3 Pains, care. E. आङ्, स्था to stay or stand, ल्युट् and ङीप् affs.
आस्थापन: आस्थापन n. (-नं) 1 Placing, fixing, causing to stay or remain. 2 An enema of oil, ghee, &c. E. आङ् before स्था to stay, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
आस्थित: आस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stayed, dwelt, abiding, abode. 2 Applied to, having recourse to. 3 Occupied, engrossed by, engaged in. 4 Spread, overspread. 5 Obtained. 6 Observing, adhering to, following, practising. E. आङ् before स्था and क्त aff.
आस्पद: आस्पद n. (-दं) 1 Business, affair. 2 Office, rank, station. 3 Dignity. 4 Authority. 5 Place, site. E. आङ् before पद to go, deriv. irr.
आस्पन्दन: आस्पन्दन n. (-नं) Trembling, throbbing. E. आङ् before स्पदि to shake, ल्युट् aff.
आस्पर्द्धा: आस्पर्द्धा f. (-र्द्धा) Emulation, rivalry. E. आङ् before स्पर्द्ध to vie with, अच् and टाप् affs.
आस्पर्द्धिन्: आस्पर्द्धिन् mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिनी-र्द्धि) Emulous. E. आस्पर्द्धा and इनि aff.
आस्फाल: आस्फाल m. (-लः) 1 Striking, rubbing, causing to move gently. 2 Flapping, clapping. 3 The flapping motion of an elephant's ear. E. आङ्, स्फल to move, causal form, घञ् aff.
आस्फालन: आस्फालन n. (-नं) 1 Pride, arrogance. 2 Rubbing, stirring, moving gently. E. आङ् before स्फल to move, causal form, affix ल्युट्.
आस्फालित: आस्फालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Struck gently, rubbed, touched, stirred. 2 Flapped, clapped, struck together. E. आङ् before स्फल to move, causal form, क्त aff.
आस्फुजित्: आस्फुजित् m. (-जित्) A name of ŚUKRA, regent of the planet VENUS, and teacher of the Asuras.
आस्फोट: आस्फोट m. (-टः) 1 A plant, (Swallow wort.) 2 The sound of striking on the arms, as made by combatants, wrestlers, &c. f. (-टा) A wild variety of jasmin. E. आङ्, स्फुट् to expand, and अच् affix; also आस्फोत and आस्फोता.
आस्फोटक: आस्फोटक m. (-कः) A tree, (Careya arborea.) E. आङ्, स्फुट् to blow, &c. and वुन् aff.
आस्फोटन: आस्फोटन n. (-नं) 1 Blowing, expanding. 2 Contracting, closing. 3 Slapping the arms, or the noise made by it. f. (-नी) A gimlet or auger. E. आङ्, स्फुट to blow or expand, and ल्युट् aff.
आस्फोत: आस्फोत m. (-तः) 1 Swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.) 2 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) 3 A kind of echites or savanna flower, (E. dichotoma, Rox.) f. (-ता) 1 A wild variety of jasmin. 2 Clitoria ternatea. E. आङ्, स्फुट to blow or expend, अच् affix and ट changed to त; or स्फै to encrease, with क्त affix, and आ converted to ओ; also sometimes आस्फोट and आस्फोटा.
आस्य: आस्य n. (-स्यं) 1 The face. 2 The mouth. mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Belonging or relating to the mouth or face. E. अस to throw or direct, and ण्यत् affix, or आङ् before स्यन्द to go, and ड affix; to which food goes or is directed. f. (-स्या) Stay, abiding, resting. E. आस to sit, and ण्यत् aff.
आस्यपत्र: आस्यपत्र n. (-त्रं) A lotus. E. आस्य a face, and पत्र a leaf; this flower is commonly compared to a beautiful face.
आस्यलाङ्गल: आस्यलाङ्गल m. (-लः) A hog, a boar. E. आस्प and लाङ्गल a plough; whose face is as it were a plough.
आस्यलोमन्: आस्यलोमन् n. (-म) The beard. E. आस्य and लामन् hair; the hair of the face.
आस्यासव: आस्यासव m. (-वः) Spittle, saliva. E. आस्य the mouth, आसव liquor.
आस्रप: आस्रप m. (-पः) The nineteenth lunar mansion. E. आस्रप a Rākṣasa or goblin, and अण् aff. one of this race being the deity of the asterism.
आस्रव: आस्रव m. (-वः) 1 Distress, pain, affliction. 2 Flow, running, discharge. E. आङ्, स्रु to go, and अच् aff.
आस्राव: आस्राव m. (-वः) 1 Pain, affliction. 2 Flow, issue, running, discharge. E. आङ्। स्रु to ooze, ण aff.
आस्वनित: आस्वनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded. E. आङ्, स्वन to sound, क्त affix, with इट् augment.
आस्वान्त: आस्वान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Sounded. E. आङ् before स्वन to sound, क्त aff.
आस्वाद: आस्वाद m. (-दः) 1 Tasting, eating. 2 Enjoying. 2 Flavour. E. आङ् before ष्वद to taste, affix घञ्.
आस्वादन: आस्वादन n. (-नं) 1 Tasting, eating. 2 Enjoying. E. आङ् before ष्वद and ल्युट् aff.
आस्वादित: आस्वादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Tasted. 2 Enjoyed, possessed. 3 Eaten. E. आङ् before ष्वद to taste, affix क्त.
आह: आह ind. An interjection, aha! ah! implying, 1 Casting, sending. 2 Severity, reproof. 3 Commanding.
आहक: आहक m. (-कः) A disease of the nose, inflammation of the Schneiderian membrane.
आहत: आहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Struck, beaten. 2 Injured, killed. 3 Multiplied. 4 Known, understood. 5 Uttered falsely. n. (-तं) 1 Old.  cloth or raiment. 2 New cloth or clothes. 3 Assertion of an impossibility. m. (-तः) A drum. E. आङ्, हन to hurt or injure, affix क्त.
आहतलक्षण: आहतलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Noted for good qualities. E. आहत known, and लक्षण a mark.
आहर: आहर m. (-रः) 1 Breath inspired, inspiration. 2 Taking, seizing. E. आङ् before हृ to take, अप् aff.
आहरण: आहरण n. (-णं) 1 Taking, seizing. 2 Causing, inducing. 3 Extracting, removing. E. आङ् before हृ to take, affix ल्युट्.
आहर्तृ: आहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) One who takes or seizes. m. (-र्त्ता) (In law,) A copy-holder. E. आङ् before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
आहर्त्तृ: आहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) One who takes or seizes. m. (-र्त्ता) (In law,) A copy-holder. E. आङ् before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
आहव: आहव m. (-वः) 1 War, battle. 2 Sacrificing. E. आङ् before हु to sacrifice or ह्वेञ् to call, and अच् aff.
आहवन: आहवन n. (-नं) Sacrifice, offering sacrifice. E. आङ् before हु to sacrifice, ल्युट् aff.
आहवनीय: आहवनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be offered as an oblation. m. (-यः) A consecrated fire taken from the householder's perpetual fire, and prepared for receiving oblations. E. आङ्, हु to offer oblations, and अनीयर् aff.
आहवनीयक: आहवनीयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Fit for a burnt offering. m. (कः) A consecrated fire. E. कन् added to the last.
आहार: आहार m. (-रः) 1 Food. 2 Taking, conveying. E. आङ्, हृ to convey, घञ् aff.
आहारसम्भव: आहारसम्भव m. (-बः) The juice of the body, chyle, lymph, serum, &c. E. आहार food, and सम्भव what is produced.
आहारार्थिन्: आहारार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Begging or seeking for food. E. आहार and अर्थिन् who asks.
आहार्य: आहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Adventitious, accessory, incidental. 2 To be taken or seized. 3 To be eaten. m. (-र्य्यः) The ornamentative part of the drama, the dress, decorations, &c. E. आङ् before हृञ् to convey, ण्यत् aff.
आहार्य्य: आहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Adventitious, accessory, incidental. 2 To be taken or seized. 3 To be eaten. m. (-र्य्यः) The ornamentative part of the drama, the dress, decorations, &c. E. आङ् before हृञ् to convey, ण्यत् aff.
आहार्यशोभा: आहार्य्यशोभा f. (-भा) Adventitious beauty, beauty not natural but the effect of pain, ornaments, &c. E. आहार्य्य incidental, and शाभा splendor.
आहार्य्यशोभा: आहार्य्यशोभा f. (-भा) Adventitious beauty, beauty not natural but the effect of pain, ornaments, &c. E. आहार्य्य incidental, and शाभा splendor.
आहाव: आहाव m. (-वः) 1 A trough near a well for watering cattle. 2 War, battle. 3 Calling. E. आङ् before ह्वे to call, घञ् affix, deriv. irr.
आहिक: आहिक m. (-कः) 1 A name of the inspired grammarian PĀṆINI. 2 The descending node. E. अहि a snake, or the constellation Aśleṣā, and ठक् aff.
आहिण्डिक: आहिण्डिक m. (-कः) A man of mixed origin, the son of a Niṣada father and Vaidehi mother, employed as a watchman on the outside of jails, &c.
आहित: आहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Placed, deposited. 2 Entertained, felt. 3 Comprising, containing. 4 Made, done. E. आङ्, धा to have or hold, part. affix क्त, form irr.
आहितलक्षण: आहितलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Noted for good qualities. E. see अहतलक्षण.
आहितव्यथ: आहितव्यथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Pained, grieved. E. आहित felt, व्यथा pain.
आहितस्वन: आहितस्वन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Noisy, uttering or making sound. E. आहित made, स्वन a sound.
आहिताङ्क: आहिताङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Marked, spotted, stained. E. आहित made, अङ्क a spot.
आहिताग्नि: आहिताग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A Brahman who has preserved a sacred fire kept alive perpetually in a family, &c. E. आहित placed, and अग्नि a fire; by whom.
आहितुण्डिक: आहितुण्डिक m. (-कः) A juggler, a snake-catcher. E. अहि a snake, तुण्ड a mouth, and ठक् affix; playing with the mouth of a snake: the poisonous fangs being extracted, the snakes are suffered to bite their exhibitors.
आहुत: आहुत n. (-तं) The nourishment of all created beings, considered as one of the five sacraments or principal sacrifices of the Hindus. E. आङ्, हु to offer oblations, and क्त aff.
आहुति: आहुति f. (-तिः) 1 Offering oblations with fire to the deities. 2 Any solemn rite accompanied with oblations. E. as the preceding, affix क्तिन्.
आहूत: आहूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Called, summoned, invoked, invited. E. आङ् before ह्वे to call, क्त aff.
आहूतप्रपलायिन्: आहूतप्रपलायिन् m. (-यी) A defendant or witness absconding, or not appearing when summoned. E. आहूत and प्रपलायिन् who runs away.
आहूति: आहूति f. (-तिः) Calling. E. आङ्, ह्वे to call, affix क्तिन्; ए is dropped, and व is changed to its analogous vowel उ.
आहृत: आहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Brought, taken collected. E. आङ् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
आहृव्य: आहृव्य ind. Having taken or received, having brought. E. आङ् before हृ to take, ल्यप् aff.
आहेय: आहेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Belonging, or relating to a snake. E. अहि a snake, and ढञ् aff.
आहो: आहो ind. 1 An interjection of doubt; 2 Of asking.
आहोपुरुषिका: आहोपुरुषिका f. (-का) Boasting, military vaunting. E. आहो, पुरूष a man, and affix कन्; doubting another's manhood, &c.
आहोस्वित्: आहोस्वित् ind. A particle implying doubt. E. आहो and स्वित् aff.
आह्न: आह्न n. (-ह्नं) Many days. E. अहन् a day, and अण् aff.
आह्निक: आह्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Daily, diurnal, of or belonging to a day. n. (-कं) 1 Constant occupation, daily work. 2 The division or section of a book. 3 Food. E. अहन् a day, and ठक् aff.
आह्निकाचार: आह्निकाचार m. (-रः) Daily observance, the prayers and practices necessary for bodily and mental purification. E. आह्निक and आचार observance.
आह्लाद: आह्लाद m. (-दः) Joy, delight. E. आङ् before ह्लद to be pleased, affix घञ्.
आह्लादित: आह्लादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, rejoiced. E. आङ्, ह्लद to be delighted, क्त aff.
आह्व: आह्व m. (-ह्वः) A crier, who or what calls. f. (-ह्वा) 1 A name, an appellation. 2 A call, a summons. E. आङ्, ह्वे to call, क aff.
आह्वय: आह्वय m. (-यः) 1 A name or appellation. 2 A lawsuit arising from a dispute about games with animals, as cockfighting, &c. E. आङ्, ह्वेञ् to call, अच् aff.
आह्वान: आह्वान n. (-नं) 1 Calling, a call or summons. 2 Legal summons. 3 A name, an appellation. 4 Invocation, invitation. E. आङ्, ह्वेञ् to call, ल्युट् aff.
आह्वानदर्शन: आह्वानदर्शन n. (-नं) Day of trial. E. आह्वान summons, and दर्शन seeing, investigating.
आह्वाय: आह्वाय m. (-यः) 1 A name 2 A summons. E. आङ्, ह्वे to call, घ aff.
आह्वायक: आह्वायक m. (-कः) A messenger, a courier. E. आङ्, ह्वे to call, ण्वुल् aff. इ
